examples: She referred to the report.
The doctor referred him to a specialist.
semantic_expansions: 提到/参考：把注意力引回某一来源或对象

words.root_logic: con-（共同）+ fer（携带）→ 共同带着意见来商谈，或把好处授予人
words.origin: 拉丁语 conferre（带到一起、授予）
words.native_definition: to award or grant, or to discuss with others
words.core_concept: bringing views together around a table, or bestowing worth on someone – 把众人意见带到一起商谈，或把一项荣誉带给人
words.core_image: 委员会围坐一处商议，最终把奖项授出
examples: The board conferred an honorary degree.
They conferred before deciding.
semantic_expansions: 授予/给予：把荣誉或权利交到人手上
商讨：把众人意见带到一处合计

words.root_logic: in-（入内）+ fer（携带）→ 从材料中把结论带出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 inferre（带入、推断），来自 in＋ferre
words.native_definition: to conclude by reasoning from evidence
words.core_concept: carrying a conclusion out from the given facts – 从已有材料中推出结论
words.core_image: 侦探从一串脚印里推出刚才发生的事
examples: We can infer the outcome from the data.
I inferred from his tone that he was angry.
semantic_expansions: 推断/推论：从已有事实中推出结论

words.root_logic: habit（居住/反复持有）→ 反复做的动作像反复住同一个地方一样固定下来
words.origin: 拉丁语 habitus（状态、习惯），来自 habere（持有）的反复体 habitare（居住）
words.native_definition: a settled regular practice, especially one hard to give up
words.core_concept: a practice one returns to as steadily as returning home – 像反复回到老住处一样稳定反复的做法
words.core_image: 同一条路每天清晨都走一遍，脚自己就知道往哪拐
examples: He has a habit of reading before bed.
Smoking is a hard habit to break.
semantic_expansions: 习惯/习性：反复做、像常驻一样稳定的行为方式
words.recall_hint: habit（居住）→ 反复回到同一处住下 → 反复做的动作固定成习惯

words.root_logic: in-（在内）+ habit（居住）→ 在某个地方里边住着
words.origin: 拉丁语 inhabitare（居住于），来自 in＋habitare
words.native_definition: to live or dwell in a place
words.core_concept: dwelling inside a place as its resident – 作为居者住在某地之内
words.core_image: 一家人搬进山谷里的小屋，从此长期住下
examples: These birds inhabit the coastal cliffs.
Thousands of species inhabit the reef.
semantic_expansions: 居住于/栖息于：作为居民长期住在某处
words.recall_hint: in-（在内）+ habit（居住）→ 住在某处里面

words.root_logic: in-（在内）+ habit（居住）+ -ant（人）→ 住在里面的人
words.origin: 拉丁语 inhabitans（居住的），来自 inhabitare（居住于）
words.native_definition: a person or animal that lives in a particular place
words.core_concept: one who dwells inside a place – 住在某地之内的人或生物
words.core_image: 山谷小屋的窗户里透出灯光，屋主一家常年住在那里
examples: The island's inhabitants rely on fishing.
Ancient inhabitants left stone circles here.
semantic_expansions: 居民/住户：长期居住在某地的成员
words.recall_hint: in-（在内）+ habit（居住）+ -ant（人）→ 住在此地的人

words.root_logic: point（刺出的点）→ 尖端、要点；动词指把注意力指向某一点
words.origin: 古法语 point（点），来自拉丁语 punctum（刺出的点）
words.native_definition: a sharp end, a particular spot, or the main idea; to direct attention to something
words.core_concept: the exact spot marked by a prick, sharp and precise – 被刺出的那个精准位置，尖而确定
words.core_image: 箭头的尖稳稳扎在靶心那一个点上
examples: The pencil has a sharp point.
Good point—let me reconsider.
She pointed at the map.
semantic_expansions: 点/尖端：刺出的尖锐位置
要点：众多话里被'点'出的核心一处
指向：把注意力引到某个点上
words.recall_hint: point（刺出的点）→ 靶尖那样精确的一处；话里的'点'即被指出要点

words.root_logic: ap-（ad- 靠向）+ point（点）→ 把某人'点'定到某个职位上
words.origin: 古法语 apointier（安排到位），来自拉丁语 ad＋punctum（点到）
words.native_definition: to choose someone for a position, or fix a time for something
words.core_concept: marking someone out to a post, or fixing a moment – 把某人点定为职位人选，或把时间定于某刻
words.core_image: 校长在名单上点出一个名字，指定他担任组长
examples: They appointed her to lead the team.
The meeting was appointed for Monday.
semantic_expansions: 任命/指派：把人点定到某个职位
约定：把时间点定为某刻
words.recall_hint: ap-（靠向）+ point（点）→ 把人点到某个职位上

words.root_logic: appoint（任命/约定）+ -ment（名词）→ 任命这件事，或约好的相会时刻
words.origin: 古法语 apointement（安排），来自 apointier（安排到位）
words.native_definition: an arrangement to meet at a set time, or the act of choosing someone for a post
words.core_concept: a fixed meeting moment, or the assigned post itself – 定好的相会时刻，或已被点定的职位
words.core_image: 日历上画着圈的那格时间，就是和牙医约好的就诊时刻
examples: I have a dentist appointment at three.
Her appointment as director was announced.
semantic_expansions: 预约/约定：定好的会面时刻
任命：被点定担任的职位
words.recall_hint: appoint（点定）+ -ment → 点定的时刻或职位

words.root_logic: limit（边界）→ 不许越过的边界；动词是给某物划下边界
words.origin: 拉丁语 limes（边界），经古法语 limite 入英语
words.native_definition: a point or line beyond which something does not or may not extend; to set such a line
words.core_concept: the boundary line one may not cross – 不允许越过的那条边界线
words.core_image: 跑道上画着终点线，冲过那根线比赛就结束
examples: There is a limit to what we can do.
Please limit your speech to five minutes.
semantic_expansions: 限度/界限：不许越过的那条边界
限制：为事物划下边界
words.recall_hint: limit（边界）→ 不许越过的线；划线即限制

words.root_logic: limit（边界）+ -ation（名词）→ 边界的存在本身，即受限制的状态
words.origin: 拉丁语 limitatio（划定边界），来自 limitare（划界）
words.native_definition: a restriction, or a weakness that restricts what someone can do
words.core_concept: the state of having a boundary drawn around one – 被划在边界内、无法越出的状态
words.core_image: 笼子再大也有边框，飞禽的活动范围到此为止
examples: The main limitation is the budget.
He knows his own limitations.
semantic_expansions: 限制/局限：被边界框住的状态
缺陷：能力被边界框住的部分
words.recall_hint: limit（边界）+ -ation → 被边界框住的状态

words.root_logic: limit（边界）+ -ed（已…的）→ 已被划下边界、范围不大的
words.origin: limit 的过去分词形式
words.native_definition: restricted in size, amount, or extent; not very large
words.core_concept: having a boundary drawn around it, small in reach – 被边界圈住、伸展余地不大
words.core_image: 一小块圈起来的实验田，只种得下几种作物
examples: The offer is available for a limited time.
His knowledge of the subject is limited.
semantic_expansions: 有限的：被边界圈住、范围不大
words.recall_hint: limit（边界）+ -ed → 被边界圈定的、范围有限

words.root_logic: govern（掌舵）→ 像舵手把握方向一样管理众人事务
words.origin: 古法语 governer，来自拉丁语 gubernare（驾驶、指挥）
words.native_definition: to control and direct a country, group, or activity
words.core_concept: steering a vessel of people along a chosen course – 像把舵一样引导众人沿既定方向行进
words.core_image: 船长端坐驾驶台，轮船按他给出的航线破浪前行
examples: The council governs the town.
Prices are governed by supply and demand.
semantic_expansions: 统治/治理：像掌舵一样把握方向管理事务
支配：规律像舵一样主导结果
words.recall_hint: govern（掌舵）→ 把握方向 → 治理一方事务

words.root_logic: govern（治理）+ -ment（名词）→ 治理一国的机构整体
words.origin: 古法语 governement（管理），来自 governer（治理）
words.native_definition: the group of people who rule a country or state
words.core_concept: the steering apparatus of a whole nation – 为整个国家把舵的那套机构
words.core_image: 议会大楼里的人们开会定策，相当于给国家掌舵的那套装置
examples: The government announced new policies.
She works for the local government.
semantic_expansions: 政府/政体：治理一国的机构整体
words.recall_hint: govern（治理）+ -ment → 治理国家的机构

words.root_logic: govern（治理）+ -or（人）→ 掌舵的人 → 一方之长
words.origin: 古法语 gouvreneur，来自拉丁语 gubernator（舵手、指挥者）
words.native_definition: the head of a state, region, or institution
words.core_concept: the person at the helm of a region or body – 为某地区或机构把舵的人
words.core_image: 楼顶旗帜猎猎，坐在主位的那人统筹着全州大小事务
examples: The governor signed the new law.
He was elected governor last year.
semantic_expansions: 州长/总督：为一方把舵的首脑
words.recall_hint: govern（治理）+ -or（人）→ 为一方掌舵的人

words.root_logic: fact（做→已做成）→ 已经做成、不会改变的事 → 事实
words.origin: 拉丁语 factum（已做成的事），facere（做）的过去分词中性形式
words.native_definition: something known to be true, especially something that can be proved
words.core_concept: a thing already done and fixed, standing firm – 已经做成、定型不变之物
words.core_image: 石碑上刻下的那行字，任谁来看都是不动的实情
examples: The fact is that we were late.
Facts speak louder than words.
semantic_expansions: 事实：已成定局、不再改变的事
（法律）既成事实 → 真相
words.recall_hint: fac（做）+ 过去分词 → 已经做成的、定型之事 → 事实

words.root_logic: fact（已做成的）+ -or（做…者）→ 参与做成某事的一个成分
words.origin: 拉丁语 factor（制造者），来自 facere（做）
words.native_definition: one of the things that helps produce a result; a number that divides another exactly
words.core_concept: one of the doers that together make a result – 合力造成某一结果的各个成分之一
words.core_image: 烹调的几味调料缺一不可，缺一味味道就变
examples: Cost is a major factor in the decision.
Two and three are factors of six.
semantic_expansions: 因素/要素：共同造成结果的一个成分
因子：把某数'做成'其整数倍的成分
words.recall_hint: fact（做）+ -or（者）→ 参与做成结果的成分

words.root_logic: fact（做）+ -ory（场所）→ 专门做东西的场所
words.origin: 拉丁语 factoria（工场），来自 factor（制造者）
words.native_definition: a building where goods are made in large quantities
words.core_concept: a place where making happens at scale – 大批量'做'东西的场所
words.core_image: 厂房里流水线不停转动，商品一件件被做出来
examples: The factory employs five hundred workers.
Cars roll off the factory line daily.
semantic_expansions: 工厂：专门大批量制造物品的场所
words.recall_hint: fact（做）+ -ory（场所）→ 做东西的地方

words.root_logic: auth（使产生）+ -or（人）→ 使作品产生的人 → 作者
words.origin: 拉丁语 auctor（创造者、发起者），经古法语 autor 入英语
words.native_definition: a person who writes a book or article, or creates something
words.core_concept: the one who brings a work into being – 使一部作品得以产生的人
words.core_image: 书桌上摊开的稿纸旁，执笔人刚刚落下最后一个句号
examples: The author signed copies of her novel.
He is the author of the plan.
semantic_expansions: 作者/著者：使作品产生的人
创始人：使某种做法或机构产生的人
words.recall_hint: auth（使产生）+ -or → 使作品产生的人

words.root_logic: auth（源头可靠）→ 出自可信源头的、非伪造的
words.origin: 希腊语 authentikos（原始的、可信的），经拉丁语 authenticus 入英语
words.native_definition: real, genuine, and not a copy or fake
words.core_concept: traceable to the true origin, not an imitation – 能追溯到真实源头、非仿制
words.core_image: 博物馆里那幅画经鉴定出自画家本人之手，笔触与署名都对得上
examples: The museum displayed an authentic painting.
The dish uses authentic spices.
semantic_expansions: 真实的/正宗的：可追溯到真实源头、非伪造
words.recall_hint: auth（源头）→ 追得到可靠源头 → 真实可信

words.root_logic: auth（使产生）+ -ority → 使事物产生并定夺的那份力量
words.origin: 拉丁语 auctoritas（权威、影响力），来自 auctor（创造者）
words.native_definition: the power to make decisions or give orders; a reliable source of information
words.core_concept: the originating power that settles things – 能定夺事物、源头可靠的那份力量
words.core_image: 裁判手中的哨子一响，场上争执即刻平息
examples: The police have authority to enforce the law.
She is an authority on ancient art.
semantic_expansions: 权威/权力：能定夺事物、让人信服的源头力量
当局：行使权力的一方机构
words.recall_hint: auth（使产生）+ -ority → 能定夺的源头力量 → 权威

words.root_logic: clar（清晰）+ -ify（使）→ 使思绪或说法变得清楚明白
words.origin: 拉丁语 clarificare（使明亮），来自 clarus（清晰的）
words.native_definition: to make something easier to understand, or to make a liquid clear
words.core_concept: making murkiness bright until it is plainly seen – 把浑浊之处照亮直到看得分明
words.core_image: 浑浊的水静置后慢慢变清，杯底杂质沉下去
examples: Could you clarify what you meant?
The liquid clarified overnight.
semantic_expansions: 澄清/阐明：把含混之处说清楚
words.recall_hint: clar（清晰）+ -ify（使）→ 使变得清楚

words.root_logic: clar（清晰）+ -ity（名词）→ 清楚明白的状态
words.origin: 拉丁语 claritas（明亮），来自 clarus（清晰的）
words.native_definition: the quality of being clear and easy to understand or see
words.core_concept: the bright state of being plainly seen – 一眼看明的明亮状态
words.core_image: 晨光下的湖面映出岸边每棵树的倒影，根根分明
examples: The report was praised for its clarity.
Water clarity improved after the rain.
semantic_expansions: 清晰/清澈：一目了然的明亮状态
words.recall_hint: clar（清晰）+ -ity → 清楚明白的状态

words.root_logic: de-（完全）+ clar（清晰）→ 把话说得完全清楚 → 公开宣布
words.origin: 拉丁语 declarare（使完全清晰），来自 de＋clarus
words.native_definition: to announce something officially or publicly
words.core_concept: speaking a matter fully clear before all – 当着众人把话说到完全明白
words.core_image: 主持人走到台前，把最终结果一字一句念给全场
examples: The government declared a state of emergency.
You must declare any gifts at customs.
semantic_expansions: 宣布/声明：公开把话说清楚
申报：向官方明确报告
words.recall_hint: de-（完全）+ clar（清晰）→ 说得全然明白 → 宣布

words.root_logic: in-（向内）+ crease（生长）→ 向内积聚地生长 → 增多
words.origin: 拉丁语 increscere（生长其中），来自 in＋crescere
words.native_definition: to become or make greater in size, number, or degree
words.core_concept: growing inward and upward until there is more – 生长累积直到数量变大
words.core_image: 雪球从山顶滚下，越滚越大、越滚越快
examples: The price of oil increased sharply.
Sales show an increase this quarter.
semantic_expansions: 增加/增长：数量或程度生长变大
words.recall_hint: in-（向内）+ crease（生长）→ 向内生长变多

words.root_logic: de-（向下）+ crease（生长）→ 生长势头向下走 → 减少
words.origin: 拉丁语 decrescere（减少），来自 de＋crescere
words.native_definition: to become or make smaller in size, number, or degree
words.core_concept: growing in the downward direction, lessening – 朝下生长的方向收缩变小
words.core_image: 退潮时水位一寸寸落下去，露出更多滩涂
examples: The number of visitors decreased last year.
There was a decrease in accidents.
semantic_expansions: 减少/下降：生长的势头向下收缩
words.recall_hint: de-（向下）+ crease（生长）→ 生长朝下走 → 减少

words.root_logic: increase（增多）+ -ingly（副词）→ 以日益增多的方式
words.origin: increase 的副词形式
words.native_definition: more and more; to an ever greater degree
words.core_concept: growing all the while, more with each step – 一直生长、一步比一步更多
words.core_image: 天色渐暗，路灯一盏接一盏亮起，街上人流愈密
examples: Life there is becoming increasingly expensive.
She increasingly prefers quiet evenings.
semantic_expansions: 越来越/日益：程度随生长不断加大
words.recall_hint: increase（增多）+ -ingly → 越来越多地

words.root_logic: gest（携带）+ -ure → 用手臂'携带'意思的动作
words.origin: 拉丁语 gestura（举止、姿态），来自 gerere（携带、做）
words.native_definition: a movement of the body that expresses meaning
words.core_concept: carrying meaning with one's body instead of words – 不用言语、用身体把意思带出去
words.core_image: 老人竖起大拇指，无需开口，赞许便送到了对方眼前
examples: She made a gesture of welcome.
Thumbs up is a universal gesture.
semantic_expansions: 手势/姿态：用身体携带并传递意思的动作
words.recall_hint: gest（携带）+ -ure → 用手势把意思带出去

words.root_logic: sug-（sub- 从下）+ gest（携带）→ 从底层悄悄带上来的意思 → 暗示
words.origin: 拉丁语 suggerere（从下面带上、提示），来自 sub＋gerere
words.native_definition: to put forward an idea for consideration, or imply something indirectly
words.core_concept: carrying an idea up from below, softly offering it – 从下方悄悄把想法带上来给人看
words.core_image: 桌下轻轻踢了一脚，话不必说出口意思已经到了
examples: I suggest we leave early.
His tone suggested doubt.
semantic_expansions: 建议：把想法带上台面供人考虑
暗示：不直说而把意思带出来
words.recall_hint: sug-（从下）+ gest（携带）→ 悄悄带上来的意思 → 暗示

words.root_logic: di-（dis- 分开）+ gest（携带）→ 把食物分开携带走 → 消化
words.origin: 拉丁语 digerere（分开、分配），来自 dis＋gerere
words.native_definition: to break down food in the body, or absorb information
words.core_concept: carrying food apart and away into the body – 把食物拆开并分别带走、吸收利用
words.core_image: 胃里像一座小磨坊，把吃下的东西慢慢磨碎化开
examples: The body digests food slowly.
It takes time to digest the news.
semantic_expansions: 消化：把食物拆开带走为身体所用
领会：把信息慢慢吸收理解
文摘：把大量内容压缩携带的读物
words.recall_hint: di-（分开）+ gest（携带）→ 把食物分开带走 → 消化

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ domin（主导）→ 排在最前面的主导 → 占主导地位的
words.origin: 拉丁语 praedominari：prae-（在前）+ dominari（统治）
words.native_definition: more important or noticeable than anything else in a group
words.core_concept: standing out in front as the master does – 像主人那样排在最前、压住全场
words.core_image: 整片山坡上就数那棵巨杉最高最粗，远远先看见它
examples: The predominant color is blue.
Agriculture is the predominant industry.
semantic_expansions: 占主导/显著：排在最前、最先被注意到的那一个
words.recall_hint: pre-（在前）+ domin（主导）→ 排在最前的主导

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ spect（看）→ 朝外看的那个念头 → 期待
words.origin: 拉丁语 exspectatio：ex-（向外）+ spectare（看）
words.native_definition: a strong belief that something will happen
words.core_concept: what one looks outward for – 朝外看去、等着它出现的东西
words.core_image: 站台边不停望向列车来的方向，心里早演好了那班车的样子
examples: She has high expectations of her students.
Sales met our expectations.
semantic_expansions: 期待/预期：朝外看等着它出现
指望：对他人表现设定的标准
words.recall_hint: ex-（向外）+ spect（看）→ 朝外看、等它出现 → 期待

words.root_logic: im-（in- 向内）+ port（携带）→ 被携带进来的分量 → 重要
words.origin: 拉丁语 importare（带入）的名词化——被带入的分量
words.native_definition: the quality of being significant or having great value
words.core_concept: weight carried into the matter – 被带进事情里的分量
words.core_image: 信封上那行字，落款人是谁，掂一下就知道轻重
examples: He stressed the importance of teamwork.
The discovery is of great importance.
semantic_expansions: 重要性：被带进事情的重量
words.recall_hint: im-（向内）+ port（携带）→ 带进来的分量 → 重要

words.root_logic: port（携带）+ -er（人）→ 帮着搬东西的人 → 搬运工
words.origin: 拉丁语 portare（携带）+ -or（者）
words.native_definition: a person whose job is carrying luggage or goods
words.core_concept: the one who carries things – 专管搬运的那个人
words.core_image: 站台上推着行李车快步走的人，旅客的大箱小包都在他车上
examples: The porter carried our bags to the room.
A hotel porter opened the door.
semantic_expansions: 搬运工：专管搬运的人
门房：看门并帮提行李的人
words.recall_hint: port（携带）+ -er → 搬东西的人

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ ced（行走）→ 走在前面的 → 前述的
words.origin: 拉丁语 praecedere：prae-（在前）+ cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: coming before something in time or order
words.core_concept: the one that goes in front – 走在前面、先到的那个
words.core_image: 翻回上一页，那行结论还在纸面上等着
examples: The preceding chapter explains the theory.
See the preceding paragraph.
semantic_expansions: 在前的/前述的：走在前面的那一个
words.recall_hint: pre-（在前）+ ced（行走）→ 走在前面的

words.root_logic: prefer（更喜欢）+ -able（可）→ 更可取、更该选的
words.origin: prefer 的形容词：prae-（在前）+ ferre（带）
words.native_definition: better or more suitable, especially compared to others
words.core_concept: the one worth carrying out in front – 更值得拿到前面来的
words.core_image: 两杯水摆着，一杯带冰一杯温的，天热时手自然伸向那杯冰的
examples: Walking is preferable to driving.
A quiet room is preferable.
semantic_expansions: 更可取：更值得拿到前面来的
words.recall_hint: prefer（更喜欢）+ -able → 更该选的

words.root_logic: cor-（相互）+ respond（回应）→ 彼此应得上的 → 相应的
words.origin: correspond 的形容词：com-（一起）+ respondere（回应）
words.native_definition: matching or connected with something else
words.core_concept: each answering to the other – 两边彼此应得上
words.core_image: 名单和座位号一一对好，拿号找座，一个都不落
examples: Sales rose, and profits showed a corresponding increase.
Fill in the corresponding boxes.
semantic_expansions: 相应/对应：两边彼此应得上
words.recall_hint: cor-（相互）+ respond（回应）→ 彼此应得上 → 相应的

words.root_logic: result（结果）+ -ant（…的）→ 作为结果而出现的
words.origin: result 的形容词：re-（回）+ salire（跳）
words.native_definition: happening as a result of something
words.core_concept: what leaps back out as the outcome – 事后蹦出来的那个结果
words.core_image: 比赛终场哨响，比分板上最终停下的那个数字
examples: The resultant damage was extensive.
Floods and the resultant chaos delayed us.
semantic_expansions: 作为结果：事后蹦出来的那个
words.recall_hint: result（结果）+ -ant → 作为结果出现的

words.root_logic: at-（ad- 朝向）+ tract（拉）→ 能把人拉过去的 → 有吸引力的
words.origin: 拉丁语 attrahere（拉近）：ad-（朝向）+ trahere（拉）
words.native_definition: pleasant to look at or pleasing to the mind
words.core_concept: pulling the eye toward it – 能把目光拉过去
words.core_image: 橱窗里那件展品，路过的人都会放慢脚步多看两眼
examples: The offer is very attractive.
She has an attractive smile.
semantic_expansions: 有吸引力：能把目光或兴趣拉过来
words.recall_hint: at-（朝向）+ tract（拉）→ 拉人过来的 → 有吸引力

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 朝向）+ cord（心）→ 心朝向同一个地方 → 一致
words.origin: 拉丁语 accordare（使同心）：ad-（朝向）+ cor/cordis（心）
words.native_definition: agreement or harmony between people; to be in agreement
words.core_concept: hearts turning toward the same point – 心朝向同一处
words.core_image: 两个人相视一点头，不用多说就知道想到一块去了
examples: The two sides reached an accord.
They acted in accord with the rules.
semantic_expansions: 一致：心朝向同一处
给予：把这份一致当作认可送出
条约：国与国达成的协定
words.recall_hint: ac-（朝向）+ cord（心）→ 心朝同一处 → 一致

words.root_logic: accord（一致）+ -ance → 一致的状态；常作 in accordance with（依照）
words.origin: accord 的名词化
words.native_definition: agreement or conformity; following a rule
words.core_concept: being in tune with the same heart – 与同一颗心合拍
words.core_image: 照着图纸一比一施工，每一个尺寸都对得上图纸
examples: The work was done in accordance with the plan.
in accordance with the law
semantic_expansions: 依照：与规定保持一致
words.recall_hint: accord（一致）+ -ance → 一致的进行

words.root_logic: according（一致）+ -ly → 与之相应地去办
words.origin: accord 的副词形式
words.native_definition: in a way that matches what was just said
words.core_concept: acting in line with the same tune – 顺着同一口径去办
words.core_image: 听到最新安排，马上把手里的计划照新口径改了
examples: The rules have changed, and we must act accordingly.
He was told the news and behaved accordingly.
semantic_expansions: 相应：照一致的标准去办
words.recall_hint: according（一致）+ -ly → 与之相应

words.root_logic: de-（向下）+ feat（做）→ 把对方做出来的局面压下去 → 击败
words.origin: 古法语 desfait：des-（去除）+ faire（做）；词根 facere（做）
words.native_definition: to win against someone; a failure to win
words.core_concept: undoing what the other side has done – 把对方做成的局面拆掉
words.core_image: 棋局最后一手落下，对方的布局被彻底拆解
examples: The team defeated its rival.
They suffered a heavy defeat.
semantic_expansions: 击败：把对方做成的事压下去
失败（名词）：被打败的结果
words.recall_hint: de-（向下）+ feat（做）→ 压掉对方所做的 → 击败

words.root_logic: feat（做）→ 做出来的不寻常之事 → 功绩
words.origin: 古法语 fait：facere（做）的过去分词
words.native_definition: an achievement that needs great skill or strength
words.core_concept: a deed that is done with skill – 做得漂亮、做得出众的事
words.core_image: 杂技演员走完高空钢索，全场屏住的那口气终于呼出
examples: The bridge is a feat of engineering.
Climbing the peak was quite a feat.
semantic_expansions: 功绩：做出众的事情
words.recall_hint: feat（做）→ 做得出众的事

words.root_logic: feat（做）+ -ure → 做出来摆给看的东西 → 特征、专题
words.origin: 古法语 faiture（制作）：facere（做）
words.native_definition: a distinctive part or quality; to include as important
words.core_concept: what is made to stand out – 特意做出来让人注意的那部分
words.core_image: 一张脸上最抓人的那双眼睛，或杂志封面主推的那篇报道
examples: The phone has many new features.
The film features a young actor.
semantic_expansions: 特征：做出来让人注意的部分
以…为特色：把某物做成主打
words.recall_hint: feat（做）+ -ure → 做出来让人注意的

words.root_logic: prob（检验）+ -ability → 检验得出的可能性大小 → 概率
words.origin: 拉丁语 probabilitas：probare（检验、证实）
words.native_definition: how likely something is to happen; chance
words.core_concept: the measured likelihood after testing – 检验之后得出的可能程度
words.core_image: 抛一百次硬币，正面朝上的次数大致各半，心里就有数了
examples: There is a high probability of rain.
The probability of failure is low.
semantic_expansions: 概率：检验得出的可能程度
words.recall_hint: prob（检验）+ -ability → 检验出的可能程度

words.root_logic: prob（检验）+ -able → 经检验很可能的 → 很可能的
words.origin: 拉丁语 probabilis：probare（检验）
words.native_definition: likely to happen or be true
words.core_concept: passing the test of likelihood – 经得起'很可能'检验的
words.core_image: 看着天上堆起来的乌云，心里判断这场雨八九成要下
examples: It is probable that he will come.
A probable cause of the delay is traffic.
semantic_expansions: 很可能：经得起可能性的检验
words.recall_hint: prob（检验）+ -able → 很可能的

words.root_logic: prob（检验）→ 伸进去验一验里面是什么 → 探查；试探
words.origin: 拉丁语 probare（检验）的名词形式
words.native_definition: a thorough investigation; to examine closely
words.core_concept: testing what lies inside – 伸进去验一验里面是什么
words.core_image: 医生轻轻试探伤口深浅，先弄清伤到哪一层，才敢判断
examples: The committee probed into the scandal.
A space probe explored the planet.
semantic_expansions: 探查：伸进去检验里面
探针：探查用的工具
words.recall_hint: prob（检验）→ 伸进去验 → 探查

words.root_logic: re-（相反）+ sist（站立）→ 立住不动地顶回去 → 抵抗
words.origin: 拉丁语 resistere：re-（相反）+ sistere（站立）；sistere 与 stare 同源
words.native_definition: to fight against something; to refuse to accept
words.core_concept: standing firm against the push – 顶着来势立住不退
words.core_image: 逆风里迈步，每一步都顶着风，人被往后推也不退
examples: They resisted the invasion.
She couldn't resist the chocolate.
semantic_expansions: 抵抗：顶着来势立住
忍住：抵御诱惑不随它走
words.recall_hint: re-（相反）+ sist（立）→ 顶着立住 → 抵抗

words.root_logic: resist（抵抗）+ -ance → 抵抗的状态或力量
words.origin: resistere 的名词化
words.native_definition: the act of fighting against something; a force opposing movement
words.core_concept: the standing firm against a push – 顶着来势立住的那股劲
words.core_image: 河道里竖起的石墩，水流冲过来，被它分开绕行
examples: The army met strong resistance.
Copper has low electrical resistance.
semantic_expansions: 抵抗：顶着来的状态
阻力：阻碍运动的力
words.recall_hint: resist（抵抗）+ -ance → 顶着的力

words.root_logic: resist（抵抗）+ -ant → 能顶住而不被改变的
words.origin: resistere 的形容词
words.native_definition: not affected or harmed by something
words.core_concept: standing firm and unyielding – 立住不被动摇
words.core_image: 刷了防水层的木船，泡在水里也不烂不渗
examples: The material is resistant to heat.
Some insects are resistant to pesticides.
semantic_expansions: 抗…的：立住不被改变
words.recall_hint: resist（抵抗）+ -ant → 能顶住的

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ stitut（立）+ -e → 一起立起来组成 → 构成
words.origin: 拉丁语 constituere：com-（一起）+ statuere（立）；statuere 与 stare 同源
words.native_definition: to form or make up something
words.core_concept: standing together to form a whole – 一起立起来拼成整体
words.core_image: 几块木板拼在一起立起来，就成了一个架子
examples: Women constitute half of the workforce.
Such actions constitute a crime.
semantic_expansions: 构成：一起立起来组成整体
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ stitut（立）→ 立起来组成 → 构成

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ stitut（立）→ 立起来使其开始运行 → 建立
words.origin: 拉丁语 instituere：in-（进入）+ statuere（立）
words.native_definition: an organization for a purpose; to set up
words.core_concept: setting something standing so it runs – 立起来让它运转
words.core_image: 把一所学校立起来，先立规矩再招生，从此年年有人进来
examples: She works at a research institute.
They instituted new safety rules.
semantic_expansions: 机构：立起来运转的组织
建立：立起让它开始运转
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ stitut（立）→ 立起来运转 → 建立

words.root_logic: sub-（在下）+ stitut（立）→ 站在下面顶替 → 替代
words.origin: 拉丁语 substituere：sub-（在下）+ statuere（立）
words.native_definition: a person or thing used instead of another; to replace
words.core_concept: one standing in below to take the place – 立在底下顶替的那个
words.core_image: 主力球员受伤下场，替补换上，位置照样有人顶住
examples: Honey can substitute for sugar.
He came on as a substitute.
semantic_expansions: 替代：站在下面顶替位置
words.recall_hint: sub-（在下）+ stitut（立）→ 站在下面顶替 → 替代

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ tin（握住）→ 连在一起握住的大陆 → 洲
words.origin: 拉丁语 continere（连在一起）：com-（一起）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: one of the large land masses of the Earth
words.core_concept: land held together in one continuous mass – 连成一片、握在一起的大陆
words.core_image: 从飞机上往下看，陆地的边界连成一大片，中间没有断
examples: Africa is a continent.
The five continents were once connected.
semantic_expansions: 大陆：连成一片、握在一起的地
洲：地球上连成整块的大陆
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ tin（握住）→ 连住的大陆

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ tin（握住）+ -ual → 一直握在一起不松 → 连续不断的
words.origin: 拉丁语 continuus：com-（一起）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: happening repeatedly without stopping
words.core_concept: held together without a break – 一直连着没断
words.core_image: 楼上装修的电钻声一阵接一阵，从早到晚没停过
examples: There was continual noise from the street.
Continual interruptions made work hard.
semantic_expansions: 连续：一直连着没断
频繁：隔不多久又来一次

semantic_expansions: 连续：一条线不断
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ tin（握）+ -uous → 不间断的

words.native_definition: materials for writing, such as paper and pens
words.core_concept: things that sit by the writing stand – 摆在书写之处的东西

examples: The shop sells stationery and books.

words.recall_hint: station（站）+ -ery → 摆在书桌边的文具

examples: Statistical analysis supports the finding.

words.recall_hint: stat（站）+ -istical → 把实况数出来

words.root_logic: sta（站立）→ 立住不动 → 停留
words.origin: 古法语 ester / rester：拉丁语 stare（站立）
words.native_definition: to remain in one place; a period of remaining

words.recall_hint: sta（站立）→ 立住不动 → 停留

examples: The offer is acceptable to both sides.

semantic_expansions: 可接受：收得下、不皱眉

words.origin: accept 的名词：ad-（朝向）+ capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: the act of taking something offered; approval
words.core_concept: taking what is offered into one's hand – 把递过来的东西接住
words.core_image: 老师傅看了一眼递来的方案，点点头接了过去
examples: Her acceptance of the job delighted us.

semantic_expansions: 接受：把递来的接住

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ cept（抓取）+ -ion → 从整体里被抓出去的那一项 → 例外
words.origin: 拉丁语 exceptio：ex-（向外）+ capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: something that does not follow the usual rule
words.core_concept: the item taken out from the whole – 从整体里被抓出来单独放的一项

examples: Everyone came, with few exceptions.
Without exception, the rules apply.
semantic_expansions: 例外：被抓出去单放的一项

words.native_definition: unusually good; out of the ordinary
words.core_concept: standing outside the common run – 立在常例之外、超出寻常
words.core_image: 别人都画三小时，她半小时就完成还最精致，明显不在一个水平线上
examples: She is an exceptional student.
The results were exceptional.

异常：与通常不同的

words.core_concept: taking the arriving one in – 把到来的人(物)接进来

examples: The reception was warm.

接收：把信号接进来
反响：外界如何接收它
words.recall_hint: re-（往回）+ cept（抓取）+ -ion → 把来客接过来

words.root_logic: en-（使）+ vis（看）+ -age → 使它在眼前显现 → 设想
words.origin: 法语 envisager：en-（在内）+ visage（面容）← visio ← videre（看）
words.native_definition: to imagine or picture something as likely to happen
words.core_concept: seeing it take shape before the eyes – 在眼前把它看成形

examples: We envisage a bright future.

words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ vis（看）+ -age → 在眼前显现 → 设想

words.root_logic: pre-（预先）+ cis（切）→ 预先切定、分毫不差的 → 精确的
words.origin: 拉丁语 praecisus：prae-（预先）+ caedere（切）——'预先切定'
words.native_definition: exact and accurate, with no error
words.core_concept: cut in advance to the exact mark – 预先切到那条准线上
words.core_image: 木匠在木料上先画好线，下刀正落线心，不偏一丝
examples: The measurements must be precise.
Give me the precise figures.
semantic_expansions: 精确：预先切定到准线
words.recall_hint: pre-（预先）+ cis（切）→ 切到准线 → 精确

words.origin: 拉丁语 confortare（使强壮）：com-（加强）+ fortis（强壮）
words.native_definition: a state of ease and calm; to soothe someone

examples: The chair offers great comfort.

semantic_expansions: 安慰：让人重新有力量
舒适：身体放松的状态
words.recall_hint: com-（加强）+ fort（强）→ 让人重新强壮 → 安慰

words.root_logic: comfort（舒适）+ -able → 能让人安顿下来的 → 舒适的
words.origin: comfort 的形容词
words.native_definition: giving ease and relaxation; at ease
words.core_concept: able to rest and recover strength – 能让人放松休整的
words.core_image: 那双旧鞋已经穿出脚形，走一天也不磨脚
examples: The bed was comfortable.
She felt comfortable in the group.

自在：不别扭、放得开
words.recall_hint: comfort（舒适）+ -able → 能安顿的

words.root_logic: ef-（ex- 出）+ fort（强）→ 把力量使出来 → 努力
words.origin: 拉丁语 exfortis：ex-（出）+ fortis（强壮）——'使出气力'
words.native_definition: physical or mental energy used to do something
words.core_concept: strength pushed out toward the task – 朝事情使出去的那股劲
words.core_image: 双手抓住箱子两端往上抬，脸都涨红了的那一下
examples: It took great effort to finish.

words.recall_hint: ef-（出）+ fort（强）→ 使出力 → 努力

words.root_logic: fortun（命运）+ -e → 命运降下的那份好坏 → 运气；财富
words.origin: 拉丁语 fortuna（命运）
words.native_definition: chance as a force in life; a large amount of money
words.core_concept: what fate hands down – 命运递到手上的那份
words.core_image: 抽奖箱里摸出一张券，展开一看中了大奖，那一下就是它
examples: Fortune smiled on them.
He made a fortune in trade.
semantic_expansions: 运气：命运降下的好坏
财富：命运眷顾带来的钱财
words.recall_hint: fortun（命运）→ 命运递来的 → 运气

words.root_logic: fortune（运气）+ -ate → 有好运气的 → 幸运的
words.origin: fortuna 的形容词
words.native_definition: having good luck or a favorable outcome
words.core_concept: receiving good from fate – 命运给了好的一份
words.core_image: 雨刚停你正好到站，一滴没淋着，运气就是这感觉
examples: We were fortunate to escape.
She is fortunate to have support.

words.native_definition: bad luck; an unfortunate event
words.core_concept: fate handing down a bad lot – 命运递来的坏一份
words.core_image: 台风过境，家里被水淹了半层，那一片狼藉就是它
examples: The flood was a great misfortune.
He bore his misfortune bravely.
semantic_expansions: 不幸：命运递来的坏一份
words.recall_hint: mis-（坏）+ fortune（运气）→ 坏运气

words.root_logic: grav（重）+ -e → 沉重的 → 严重的；坟，埋重的那处
words.origin: 拉丁语 gravis（重）；名词'坟'义来自日耳曼语 gräf（挖），撞音
words.native_definition: serious and worrying; a place of burial
words.core_concept: heavy with weight or worry – 压得人心沉的
words.core_image: 医生的表情一下沉下来，那句诊断还没说出口，气氛已经压住了

words.origin: 拉丁语 gravitas：gravis（重）

严肃：压着不轻浮的分量

words.root_logic: ag-（ad- 加强）+ grav（重）+ -ate → 使更重 → 加重

words.native_definition: to make something worse or more serious

examples: Stress aggravates the condition.

words.recall_hint: ag-（加强）+ grav（重）+ -ate → 更重 → 加重

words.root_logic: con-（共同）+ tempor（时间）+ -ary → 同处一个时代的 → 当代的

words.core_concept: sharing the same time as now – 与当下同处一个时刻

examples: Contemporary art challenges tradition.
They are contemporary writers.

同时代：与他人同处一时
words.recall_hint: con-（共同）+ tempor（时间）→ 同处一时

words.root_logic: tempor（时间）+ -ary → 只属于一段时间的 → 临时的
words.origin: 拉丁语 temporarius：tempus（时间）
words.native_definition: lasting only for a limited time
words.core_concept: bound to a stretch of time, not forever – 只占一段时间、不永久

examples: She took a temporary job.
The road is closed temporarily.
semantic_expansions: 临时：只占一段时间
words.recall_hint: tempor（时间）+ -ary → 只属一段时间的

words.root_logic: temper（调和）→ 按时得当的调配 → 脾气；使缓和
words.origin: 拉丁语 temperare（调和、使适中）——tempus 的'按时得当'引申
words.native_definition: a person's mood or nature; to make something less extreme
words.core_concept: mixing to the right measure at the right time – 按分寸调配
words.core_image: 调酒师把几种酒按比例兑在一起，最后那一下点味
examples: She has a calm temper.
He tempered the criticism with praise.

words.root_logic: tempt（试探）→ 试探一个人的定力 → 引诱
words.origin: 拉丁语 temptare（试探、尝试）
words.native_definition: to attract or lure someone to do something, often wrong
words.core_concept: probing one's resolve – 试探一个人的定力
words.core_image: 橱窗里的甜点摆得诱人，路过时脚就不由自主往那边挪
examples: The offer tempted him.
Don't tempt me with chocolate.
semantic_expansions: 引诱：试探定力
诱惑：把意志动摇
words.recall_hint: tempt（试探）→ 试探定力 → 引诱

words.root_logic: at-（ad- 朝向）+ tempt（试探）→ 朝目标试一下 → 尝试
words.origin: 拉丁语 attemptare：ad-（朝向）+ temptare（试探）
words.native_definition: to try to do something; an effort to do something
words.core_concept: reaching out to test the way – 伸手朝目标探路
words.core_image: 第一次滑冰，扶着栏杆小心翼翼地迈出第一步，试了试站不站得稳
examples: She attempted the climb.
His attempt failed.
semantic_expansions: 尝试：朝目标试一下
words.recall_hint: at-（朝向）+ tempt（试探）→ 朝目标试 → 尝试

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ tempt（试探）→ 看穿之后轻慢地对待 → 蔑视
words.origin: 拉丁语 contemptus：com-（完全）+ temptare（试探）——'看透了'
words.native_definition: a strong feeling of disliking and despising
words.core_concept: dismissing after probing and finding nothing worthy – 试探后觉得不屑一顾
words.core_image: 对那种当面一套背后一套的做法，他只斜眼看了下就不再正眼
examples: She looked at him with contempt.
He has contempt for cheats.

words.recall_hint: con-（完全）+ tempt（试探）→ 看透而不屑 → 蔑视

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ concili（使和好）→ 使重新和好 → 和解；调和
words.origin: 拉丁语 reconciliare：re-（再）+ conciliare（使和好）
words.native_definition: to make two things or people compatible again
words.core_concept: bringing the estranged back together – 把闹翻的重新拢到一处
words.core_image: 兄弟为遗产争了多年，最终坐下来把旧账一笔笔说清，重归于好
examples: They reconciled after the quarrel.
It is hard to reconcile the two accounts.
semantic_expansions: 和解：使重新和好
调和：把矛盾摆平
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ concili（和好）→ 重新和好

words.root_logic: com-（共同）+ par（对等）+ -able → 能放到同一天平上比 → 可比较的

words.core_concept: able to be set on the same scale – 能放上同一杆秤
words.core_image: 两款手机摆在展台并列，屏幕、价格、厚度都能放一起权衡
examples: The two products are comparable.
His salary is comparable to mine.

类似：同一档次的
words.recall_hint: com-（共同）+ par（对等）→ 能同秤比较

words.root_logic: par（对等）→ 两个对等的东西 → 一对
words.origin: 古法语 paire ← 拉丁语 paria（对等物）← par（相等）
words.native_definition: two things of the same kind used together
words.core_concept: two matched, equal things – 两个对等相配的东西
words.core_image: 抽屉里两只袜子花色相同，摆在一处正好齐整，少了一只就不成样子
examples: He bought a pair of shoes.
The students paired up to practice.
semantic_expansions: 一对：两个相配的东西
words.recall_hint: par（对等）→ 两个对等 → 一对

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ pair（对等/使就绪）→ 重新使恢复到某种状态 → 修理
