words.native_definition: to fix something broken or damaged
words.core_concept: making it ready again as before – 把它重新弄回原样
words.core_image: 自行车链条掉了，蹲下来一节节挂回齿轮，车又能骑了
examples: He repaired the broken chair.
The bridge needs repair.
semantic_expansions: 修理：重新弄回原样
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ pair（使就绪）→ 弄回原样

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pile（堆）→ 把散件堆到一起 → 汇编
words.origin: 拉丁语 compilare：com-（一起）+ pilare（堆垛）
words.native_definition: to collect information together to make a report or book
words.core_concept: heaping scattered pieces into one pile – 把零散的都拢成堆
words.core_image: 把历年数据一行行摘下来，排成整齐的表格编成册
examples: The researchers compiled the data.
They compiled a list of sources.
semantic_expansions: 汇编：把散件堆拢成册
words.recall_hint: com-（一起）+ pile（堆）→ 堆到一起 → 汇编

words.root_logic: ob-（朝向）+ edi（听）→ 朝着喊话的方向听 → 服从
words.origin: 拉丁语 oboedientia：ob-（朝向）+ audire（听）——'听着办'
words.native_definition: willingness to follow orders or rules
words.core_concept: hearing the direction and acting on it – 听清了照着办
words.core_image: 老师一声令下，全班齐刷刷坐好，动作整齐一致
examples: The dog was trained to obedience.
Obedience to the law is expected.
semantic_expansions: 服从：听清了就照办
words.recall_hint: ob-（朝向）+ edi（听）→ 听着办 → 服从

words.root_logic: ob-（朝向）+ edi（听）+ -ent → 愿意听着办的 → 顺从的
words.origin: oboediens 分词：ob-（朝向）+ audire（听）
words.native_definition: willing to do what one is told
words.core_concept: one who hears and follows – 听着就办的
words.core_image: 训练有素的马儿听到缰绳的轻响就转向，不闹脾气
examples: The obedient dog stayed by his side.
She was an obedient student.
semantic_expansions: 顺从：听着就照办
words.recall_hint: ob-（朝向）+ edi（听）+ -ent → 听着就办

words.root_logic: pre-（更）+ val（强）→ 比别处都强、都普及 → 流行的
words.origin: 拉丁语 praevalere：prae-（更）+ valere（强）
words.native_definition: existing commonly or widely at a given time
words.core_concept: being the strongest presence around – 在四周占优势地存在
words.core_image: 这座城到处都立着同一家奶茶店的招牌，走两步就撞见一家
examples: The habit is prevalent in rural areas.
Flu is prevalent in winter.
semantic_expansions: 流行：占优势地到处存在
words.recall_hint: pre-（更）+ val（强）→ 到处都强 → 流行

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ vi（路）→ 在路前面、先走到的 → 先前的
words.origin: 拉丁语 praevius：prae-（在前）+ via（路）
words.native_definition: existing or happening before this one
words.core_concept: the one that walked ahead on the road – 在路上先走到的那个
words.core_image: 翻回上一所学校的学生证，照片里是更年轻的脸
examples: She had a previous job.
I met him on a previous visit.
semantic_expansions: 先前：在路上先走到
words.recall_hint: pre-（在前）+ vi（路）→ 先走上路的

words.root_logic: hum（拟声）→ 低沉持续的嗡嗡声
words.origin: 英语拟声词，模仿嗡嗡声；与拉丁 hum（湿）无关
words.native_definition: to make a low continuous sound; a low continuous sound
words.core_concept: the low steady buzz that fills a quiet room – 充满屋子的低鸣
words.core_image: 夏天傍晚风扇低低震着耳朵，关掉反而觉得少了什么
examples: The machine hummed all night.
She hummed a tune.
semantic_expansions: 嗡嗡响：低沉持续的鸣声
哼歌：闭着唇哼出的调子
words.recall_hint: hum（拟声）→ 嗡嗡声

words.root_logic: humor（体液）→ 古人认为体液决定性情 → 幽默
words.origin: 拉丁语 humor（湿气、体液）
words.native_definition: the quality of being funny; mood
words.core_concept: the disposition born of one's humours – 由体液定下的那份性情
words.core_image: 台上那人几句话说下来，全场笑声此起彼伏，气氛一下就活了
examples: His humor lightened the room.
She was in good humor today.
semantic_expansions: 幽默：让人发笑的本事
情绪：当下心气的好坏
words.recall_hint: humor（体液）→ 定性情的湿度 → 幽默

words.root_logic: humor（幽默）+ -ous → 有幽默感的 → 幽默的
words.origin: humor 的形容词
words.native_definition: funny and entertaining
words.core_concept: carrying a humour that makes people smile – 带趣味、逗人笑
words.core_image: 饭桌上他讲的那个段子，大家都笑了，连不苟言笑的老爸都弯了嘴角
examples: The book is humorous and warm.
He made a humorous remark.
semantic_expansions: 幽默：逗人发笑的
words.recall_hint: humor（幽默）+ -ous → 逗人笑的

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ cess（走）→ 一起往后让 → 让步
words.origin: 拉丁语 concessio：con-（一起）+ cedere（退让）
words.native_definition: something given up or allowed
words.core_concept: yielding ground together – 一起往后退让的那份
words.core_image: 谈判桌上，一方把价格往下调了一档，另一方也松了口
examples: He made a concession on price.
The store runs a food concession.
semantic_expansions: 让步：退让一份
特许：被让出的经营权
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ cess（走）→ 一起退让

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ cis（切）→ 把废话切掉 → 简明的
words.origin: 拉丁语 concisus：con-（完全）+ caedere（切）——'切短的'
words.native_definition: short and clear, with no extra words
words.core_concept: cut down to essentials – 切掉多余、只剩要点
words.core_image: 会议纪要只留三行，废话全删，一眼看完
examples: The summary was concise and clear.
Keep your answers concise.
semantic_expansions: 简明：切掉废话只剩要点
words.recall_hint: con-（完全）+ cis（切）→ 切短的

words.root_logic: com-（完全）+ ply（填满）→ 满足全部要求 → 遵从
words.origin: 拉丁语 complere：com-（完全）+ plere（填满）
words.native_definition: to obey a rule or law
words.core_concept: filling the requirement completely – 把它填到满足
words.core_image: 接到整改通知后，把每一条要求都做到位，检查组来查样样达标
examples: All staff must comply with the rules.
The firm failed to comply.
semantic_expansions: 遵从：把要求填满到位
words.recall_hint: com-（完全）+ ply（填满）→ 填满要求

words.root_logic: suit（跟随）→ 跟着身体的形状走 → 合身、适合
words.origin: 古法语 suite/suivre ← 拉丁语 sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: to be right for someone; a set of clothes
words.core_concept: following a shape or situation exactly – 贴身跟随、正好合适
words.core_image: 那件西装上身，肩线正落肩头，裤长恰好及鞋面，哪哪都服帖
examples: The color suits her.
He wore a grey suit.
semantic_expansions: 适合：刚好跟上了
套装：成套相配的衣裳
诉讼：跟进的一项程序
words.recall_hint: suit（跟随）→ 贴身合适

words.root_logic: suit（适合）+ -able → 合适的
words.origin: suit 的形容词
words.native_definition: right for a particular purpose or person
words.core_concept: able to follow the need exactly – 正好匹配那份需要
words.core_image: 下雨天换上这双防滑鞋，走哪一段路都不打滑
examples: This is a suitable place for the camp.
Find a suitable time to call.
semantic_expansions: 合适：正好匹配需要
words.recall_hint: suit（适合）+ -able → 合适的

words.root_logic: suite（跟随的一系列）→ 一串相随的东西
words.origin: 法语 suite（随行）← seguir ← sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: a set of connected rooms; a set of musical pieces
words.core_concept: a series following one after another – 一串连续相随的
words.core_image: 酒店里连着的一套客房，客厅卧室洗手间一溜排开
examples: They rented a hotel suite.
The pianist played a suite.
semantic_expansions: 套房：一连串相通的房间
words.recall_hint: suite（跟随的一系列）→ 相连成套

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ vent（来）→ 先一步来到 → 阻止
words.origin: 拉丁语 praevenire：prae-（在前）+ venire（来）
words.native_definition: to stop something from happening
words.core_concept: coming before it so it can't happen – 抢在它前面赶到
words.core_image: 看到前方封路，一脚刹车停住，车没冲进施工区
examples: The guard prevented the theft.
Vaccine prevents the disease.
semantic_expansions: 阻止：抢在前面赶到
预防：事先防住
words.recall_hint: pre-（在前）+ vent（来）→ 先一步到 → 阻止

words.root_logic: hospes（主/客）一支 → 开门接纳来者、张罗招待的那一方
words.origin: 古法语 hoste，来自拉丁语 hospes（主人与客人同词），与 hostis 同源
words.native_definition: a person who receives and entertains guests; also a large number of things
words.core_concept: the one who takes in whoever arrives and sees to them – 接纳来者并一手张罗的那方
words.core_image: 门一开，来者被让进屋，茶已经斟在桌上
examples: The host welcomed every guest at the door.
A host of problems followed the storm.
semantic_expansions: 主人/主持人：接纳来者并张罗招待的一方
大量：如同一屋子挤满来客，多到成群
words.recall_hint: hospes（主/客）→ 开门接纳来者的那一方

words.root_logic: hoste（客）+ -age → 留在对方手里的「客」，实为被扣下作抵的人
words.origin: 古法语 ostage（寄居、抵押），来自 hoste（客），源头同 hospes/hostis
words.native_definition: a person held captive as security until demands are met
words.core_concept: a guest turned pledge, kept until terms are met – 由客转为抵押，扣着等对方应条件
words.core_image: 旅人被留在营中不得走，成了对方开条件的凭据
examples: The gunmen held three hostages inside.
He was taken hostage on the border.
semantic_expansions: 人质：被扣下充作抵押的来人
words.recall_hint: hoste（客）+ -age → 被扣在对方手里充抵的来人

words.root_logic: host（主人）+ -ess（阴性）→ 出面招待来客的女性一方
words.origin: 英语 hostess，host 加阴性后缀 -ess
words.native_definition: a woman who receives and entertains guests
words.core_concept: the woman who takes in arrivals and sees to them – 出面接纳并招待来者的女方
words.core_image: 她举杯招呼满屋来客，一张张桌子都照看过来
examples: The hostess showed us to our seats.
She works as an air hostess.
semantic_expansions: 女主人/女主持人：出面接纳并招待来者的女方
words.recall_hint: host（招待方）+ -ess（阴性）→ 出面招待来者的女方

words.root_logic: hostis（外来者→对头）+ -ile → 摆出对头架势的
words.origin: 拉丁语 hostilis（属于 hostis 的），来自 hostis（外来者、对头）
words.native_definition: unfriendly and aggressive; showing strong opposition
words.core_concept: wearing the temper of the one barred at the door – 摆出门口横身挡道那种架势
words.core_image: 来者脸色不善，话里透着要开仗的意思
examples: The crowd turned hostile within minutes.
They faced hostile questions all evening.
semantic_expansions: 敌意的/敌对的：摆出挡道对峙的那副架势
words.recall_hint: hostis（门外对头）+ -ile → 摆出对峙架势的

words.root_logic: con-（一并）+ cern（筛分）→ 一并筛进来跟自己有牵连 → 牵动心思
words.origin: 拉丁语 concernere（混在一起筛、相关），来自 con＋cernere
words.native_definition: to be about something, or to make someone anxious; such anxiety
words.core_concept: being sifted into the same pile as a matter, so it weighs on one – 被筛进同一堆里，事情便挂在心上
words.core_image: 消息传来，他一夜没合眼，反复过着那桩事
examples: This rule concerns everyone in the building.
Her silence caused real concern.
semantic_expansions: 涉及：被筛进同一堆、与之有牵连
关心/担忧：牵连到自己，于是挂在心上
words.recall_hint: con-（一并）+ cern（筛分）→ 被筛进同一堆 → 有牵连、挂心上

words.root_logic: concern（牵涉）的分词转介词 → 就所牵涉的那件事而言
words.origin: 英语 concerning，concern 的现在分词转作介词
words.native_definition: about; with reference to a particular matter
words.core_concept: pointing at the very pile a matter was sifted into – 直指某事被归进的那一堆
words.core_image: 信里逐条写的，都紧扣那笔款的来龙去脉
examples: He asked several questions concerning the delay.
We had no news concerning her whereabouts.
semantic_expansions: 关于/有关：就所牵涉的那一桩而言
words.recall_hint: concern（牵涉）+ -ing → 就所牵涉的那桩而言

words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ cern（筛分）→ 一层层筛开，直到看出分别
words.origin: 拉丁语 discernere（区分开来），来自 dis＋cernere
words.native_definition: to recognize or make out something with effort
words.core_concept: sifting the layers apart until the thing stands out – 层层筛开，直到那物凸显出来
words.core_image: 隔着晨雾眯眼细看，岸上那道影子终于显出轮廓
examples: She could just discern a figure in the fog.
It is hard to discern his true motive.
semantic_expansions: 辨别/认出：筛开混杂后把那物分出来
洞悉：筛到底层、连内里也看出来
words.recall_hint: dis-（分开）+ cern（筛分）→ 筛开层层，看出分别

words.root_logic: lev（举起）+ -er（工具）→ 用来把重物撬起来的那根杆
words.origin: 古法语 levier（撬棒），来自 lever（举起）← 拉丁语 levare
words.native_definition: a bar used to prise something up; a means of exerting pressure
words.core_concept: the bar that raises a weight far heavier than the hand pressing it – 以小力撬起远重于手劲之物的杆
words.core_image: 长杆一头垫住石块，另一头轻轻下压，巨石离地
examples: He used an iron bar as a lever.
Tax breaks became a political lever.
semantic_expansions: 杠杆：以小力撬起重物的那根杆
手段：像撬杆一样能撬动局面的着力处
words.recall_hint: lev（举起）+ -er（工具）→ 撬起重物的那根杆

words.root_logic: lev（举起）→ 把款项或人手「举」起收拢到官府手里
words.origin: 古法语 levee（收取、征集），来自 lever（举起）← 拉丁语 levare
words.native_definition: to impose and collect a tax or troops; the amount so raised
words.core_concept: raising a sum or a body of men out of the populace – 从民间把银钱或人手举收上来
words.core_image: 官府张榜，按册向各户收取银钱
examples: The council levied a new charge on parking.
A levy was placed on imported goods.
semantic_expansions: 征收/税款：从民间举收上来的银钱
征募：同样手法举收人手入伍
words.recall_hint: lev（举起）→ 从民间举收银钱或人手

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ lev（举起）+ -ant → 能把话题重新托举起来的 → 搭得上
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 relevans（托起、有助于），来自 relevare（再举起）
words.native_definition: closely connected with the matter being discussed
words.core_concept: able to lift the matter at hand rather than hang off it – 托得起眼下这桩事，而非旁挂
words.core_image: 他提的两点正落在会上要议的那桩事上
examples: Please bring any relevant paperwork.
That remark was hardly relevant here.
semantic_expansions: 相关的/切题的：托得起眼下这桩事、搭得上
words.recall_hint: re-（回）+ lev（举起）→ 把眼下话题托举得起 → 搭得上

words.root_logic: mus（缪斯）+ -ic（…的技艺）→ 缪斯所司的声律技艺
words.origin: 希腊语 mousike（缪斯的技艺）经拉丁语 musica、古法语 musique 入英语
words.native_definition: sounds arranged in a pleasing or ordered way
words.core_concept: sound set in order so the ear follows it – 把声响排布成序，耳朵便跟得上
words.core_image: 琴弦一拨，满室的说话声就静了下来
examples: She has listened to this music all week.
The music grew louder as we entered.
semantic_expansions: 音乐/乐曲：排布成序、耳朵跟得上的声响
words.recall_hint: mus（缪斯）+ -ic → 缪斯所司的声律技艺

words.root_logic: music（声律技艺）+ -al（…的）→ 属于声律的、听着顺耳的
words.origin: 英语 musical，music 加形容词后缀 -al
words.native_definition: relating to sound arranged in order; pleasant to hear
words.core_concept: belonging to ordered sound, so it falls kindly on the ear – 属于有序声响，故听来顺耳
words.core_image: 这孩子开口一唱，调子准得让人侧耳
examples: He comes from a musical family.
She spoke in a soft, musical voice.
semantic_expansions: 音乐的：属于声律技艺的
悦耳的：合于法度，听来顺耳
words.recall_hint: music（声律）+ -al → 属于声律的、听来顺耳

words.root_logic: music（声律技艺）+ -ian（司此业者）→ 以声律技艺为业的人
words.origin: 古法语 musicien，来自拉丁语 musicus（通声律者）
words.native_definition: a person who plays or writes music, especially as a job
words.core_concept: one whose craft is ordered sound – 以有序声响为业的人
words.core_image: 台上几人调好弦，静候指挥落棒
examples: The musician tuned her violin.
He became a professional musician at twenty.
semantic_expansions: 音乐家/乐手：以声律技艺为业的人
words.recall_hint: music（声律）+ -ian（司此业者）→ 以声律为业的人

words.root_logic: ars（手上本事）→ 练出来的门道，及其做出的作品
words.origin: 古法语 art，来自拉丁语 ars/artis（手艺、门道）
words.native_definition: the making of things meant to be looked at or admired; a learned skill
words.core_concept: what the trained hand brings forth, and the knack behind it – 练过的手所成之物，及其中门道
words.core_image: 画布上一笔一笔堆出光影，看的人半晌没说话
examples: She studied art for four years.
There is an art to asking good questions.
semantic_expansions: 艺术/美术：练出的手所成、供人观览之物
技艺：做成此物背后的那套门道
words.recall_hint: ars（手上练出的本事）→ 门道，及其做出的作品

words.root_logic: art（手艺）+ -ist（司此业者）→ 以这门手上功夫为业的人
words.origin: 法语 artiste，来自中世纪拉丁语 artista（通艺者）← ars
words.native_definition: a person who makes paintings, sculpture, or other such works
words.core_concept: one whose trade is the trained hand's making – 以练出的手做东西为业的人
words.core_image: 他在阁楼里对着画架站了一整天，颜料蹭到袖口
examples: The artist worked in oils and charcoal.
She is a well-known artist in this city.
semantic_expansions: 艺术家/画家：以练出的手做东西为业的人
words.recall_hint: art（手艺）+ -ist（司此业者）→ 以此手艺为业的人

words.root_logic: artist（司艺者）+ -ic（…的）→ 见得出手上门道的、有讲究的
words.origin: 英语 artistic，artist 加形容词后缀 -ic
words.native_definition: showing skill and taste in making or arranging things
words.core_concept: bearing the mark of a trained hand's judgement – 带着练过的手那份分寸
words.core_image: 这只陶碗的弧线收得讲究，摆上桌就压住了满桌俗气
examples: The room had an artistic arrangement of flowers.
He has real artistic talent.
semantic_expansions: 艺术的/有美感的：带着练过的手那份分寸与讲究
words.recall_hint: artist（司艺者）+ -ic → 见得出手上门道的、有讲究的

words.root_logic: ordo（行列）→ 各就其位的排布；由「排定」引申为排定要办之事、要买之货
words.origin: 古法语 ordre，来自拉丁语 ordo/ordinis（行列、次序）
words.native_definition: the way things are arranged; an instruction to do something; a request for goods
words.core_concept: things standing each in its place, and the word that puts them there – 各就其位的排布，以及使其就位的那句话
words.core_image: 书脊按高矮一列排开，谁也不越位；掌事的一句话下来，各人照着做
examples: Please put the files back in order.
The captain ordered them to wait.
semantic_expansions: 顺序/秩序：各就其位的那个排布
命令：使各人就位去办的那句话
订单：把要买之货排定下来
words.recall_hint: ordo（行列）→ 各就其位；使之就位便是发话与排定

words.root_logic: dis-（离散）+ order（各就其位）→ 位次散了 → 乱；身体位次乱了即病症
words.origin: 法语 désordre（无秩序），dis-＋ordre ← 拉丁语 ordo
words.native_definition: a state of confusion; also an illness that upsets normal function
words.core_concept: the row broken up, nothing standing where it should – 行列散开，无一物在该在的位上
words.core_image: 抽屉被翻得底朝天，东西全不在原处
examples: The room was left in complete disorder.
He suffers from a sleep disorder.
semantic_expansions: 混乱：行列散开、无物在其位
失调/疾病：身体各处的位次乱了
words.recall_hint: dis-（离散）+ order（就位）→ 位次散乱

words.root_logic: order（各就其位）+ -ly（…样的）→ 一眼看去各在其位的
words.origin: 英语 orderly，order 加后缀 -ly
words.native_definition: neatly arranged; behaving in a controlled way
words.core_concept: keeping the row unbroken, each in place – 行列不散，各守其位
words.core_image: 队伍一列列排开，间距分毫不差
examples: They formed an orderly queue at the gate.
She keeps an orderly desk.
semantic_expansions: 整齐的/有条理的：行列不散、各守其位
words.recall_hint: order（就位）+ -ly → 各在其位、看去不散

words.root_logic: origo（涌出之处）→ 事物最初冒出来的那一处，及人的出处
words.origin: 法语 origine，来自拉丁语 origo/originis（发端）← oriri（升起）
words.native_definition: the point or cause from which something begins; a person's ancestry
words.core_concept: the spot where a thing first rises into being – 那物最初冒出来的那一处
words.core_image: 顺着溪流一路上溯，直到山间那眼冒水的泉口
examples: The origin of the fire is still unknown.
She is proud of her humble origins.
semantic_expansions: 起源/起点：事物最初涌出的那一处
出身：人所从来的那一处
words.recall_hint: origo（涌出之处）→ 最初冒出来的那一点

words.root_logic: origin（发端）+ -al（…的）→ 处在最初那一处的；也指头一份实物
words.origin: 古法语 original，来自拉丁语 originalis（属于发端的）
words.native_definition: existing from the start; new and not copied; the first version of a thing
words.core_concept: standing at the rising point, before any copy – 立在涌出那一处，尚无摹本
words.core_image: 抽屉里那张手稿是头一份，后来的都照着它抄
examples: The house keeps its original windows.
Please send me the original, not a copy.
semantic_expansions: 最初的：立在发端那一处的
原创的：从自己那处涌出、非摹自他人
原件：头一份实物，摹本之前的那个
words.recall_hint: origin（发端）+ -al → 处在最初那一处、尚无摹本

words.root_logic: origin（发端）+ -ate（使…）→ 自某处涌出、由某处发端
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 originare（发端于），来自 origo
words.native_definition: to begin in a particular place or from a particular cause
words.core_concept: to come rising out of a given spot – 自某一处冒出来
words.core_image: 这条河的水，是从那道石缝里第一次涌出来的
examples: The custom originated in southern Spain.
The idea originated with her, not him.
semantic_expansions: 起源于/发源：自某处涌出来
创始：使某物从自己这处涌出
words.recall_hint: origin（发端）+ -ate → 自某处涌出来

words.root_logic: pactum（已钉牢之事）→ 双方钉定下来的约
words.origin: 拉丁语 pactum（协议），pacisci（缔约）的过去分词，源于 pangere（钉牢）
words.native_definition: a formal agreement between two or more sides
words.core_concept: the terms driven fast so neither side may shift them – 条款被钉牢，两边都不得再挪
words.core_image: 两方在纸上各按一个手印，从此照纸上写的办
examples: The two nations signed a trade pact.
They made a pact never to speak of it.
semantic_expansions: 协定/条约：被钉牢、双方不得再挪的约
words.recall_hint: pactum（钉牢之事）→ 双方钉定下来的约

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pact（钉合）→ 各部分钉合在一起、不占地方的
words.origin: 拉丁语 compactus，compingere（拼合钉牢）的过去分词，来自 com＋pangere
words.native_definition: closely packed into a small space; neatly small
words.core_concept: parts driven together so no gap is left – 各部分钉合到一处，不留空隙
words.core_image: 行李被压得严丝合缝，箱盖一扣还有余地
examples: The flat has a compact kitchen.
Snow was compact underfoot.
semantic_expansions: 紧密的：各部分钉合到一处、不留空隙
小巧的：因钉合紧密而不占地方
words.recall_hint: com-（一起）+ pact（钉合）→ 钉合到一处、不留空隙

words.root_logic: im-（in- 向内）+ pact（钉入）→ 直钉进去的那一下 → 撞击及其后果
words.origin: 拉丁语 impactus，impingere（撞入、钉入）的过去分词，来自 in＋pangere
words.native_definition: the force of one thing striking another; a marked effect on something
words.core_concept: the blow of being driven into a thing, and what it leaves behind – 钉进去那一下，以及留下的后果
words.core_image: 石子砸进水面，波纹一圈圈荡到岸边
examples: The impact shattered the windscreen.
New rules had a real impact on costs.
semantic_expansions: 撞击：直钉进去那一下
影响/冲击：那一下过后留在事物上的后果
words.recall_hint: im-（向内）+ pact（钉入）→ 钉进去那一下及其后果

words.root_logic: as-（ad- 靠向）+ sert（串连）→ 把话一句扣一句地接稳 → 断言
words.origin: 拉丁语 asserere（宣称、主张），来自 ad＋serere（连上）
words.native_definition: to state something firmly as true; to make others recognize a right
words.core_concept: linking one's words tight to a claim and standing on it – 把话紧扣在主张上，站定不退
words.core_image: 他把三条依据一条接一条摆上桌，语气不留退路
examples: She asserted that the data was sound.
He asserted his right to speak.
semantic_expansions: 断言/声称：把话紧扣在主张上说定
维护：把自己的权利扣住不放
words.recall_hint: as-（靠向）+ sert（串连）→ 把话扣紧在主张上

words.root_logic: de-（脱开）+ sert（串连）→ 把串连解开、撇下不管 → 抛弃
words.origin: 拉丁语 deserere（解开连结、弃置），来自 de＋serere；与甜品 dessert（法语 desservir 清桌）无关，勿混
words.native_definition: to abandon someone or something, especially a duty or post
words.core_concept: unhooking oneself from the row and walking off – 把自己从串上解开走掉
words.core_image: 队伍还在原地，他半夜把装备一扔就走了
examples: He deserted his post before dawn.
She felt deserted by her closest friends.
semantic_expansions: 抛弃/遗弃：把自己从串连中解开、撇下不管
擅离：擅自脱开本该守住的那一环
words.recall_hint: de-（脱开）+ sert（串连）→ 从串上解开走掉

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ sert（串连）→ 把一物插进串里、接进队列
words.origin: 拉丁语 inserere（插入、嵌进），来自 in＋serere
words.native_definition: to put something into something else, or between other things
words.core_concept: opening the row to let one more link take its place – 把串挑开，让一枚补进那一环
words.core_image: 把新的一颗珠子挑进线上，两边一收又是整串
examples: Insert the card into the slot.
They inserted a clause into the contract.
semantic_expansions: 插入/嵌入：把一物接进串里的那一环
刊登：把文字插进版面里
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ sert（串连）→ 插进串里补上一环

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ hibit（持有）→ 把手里的东西拿出来给人看
words.origin: 拉丁语 exhibere（拿出、呈现），来自 ex＋habere
words.native_definition: to show something publicly, or to display a quality
words.core_concept: holding a thing out where others may see it – 把攥住的东西伸出去让人看
words.core_image: 他摊开掌心，把那枚旧币举到灯下让众人看
examples: The museum will exhibit her early work.
He exhibited no sign of fear.
semantic_expansions: 展出/展示：把持有之物拿出来给人看
表现出：把内里的性质显露到外面
words.recall_hint: ex-（向外）+ hibit（持有）→ 把手里的拿出来给人看

words.root_logic: in-（向内）+ hibit（持有）→ 往回攥住不放 → 抑制
words.origin: 拉丁语 inhibere（拉住、制止），来自 in＋habere
words.native_definition: to hold back a process or feeling; to make someone self-conscious
words.core_concept: keeping the hand closed so the thing cannot come out – 手往回收，使之出不来
words.core_image: 话到嘴边又被咽了回去，掌心攥得更紧
examples: The drug inhibits the growth of bacteria.
Fear of failure inhibited her.
semantic_expansions: 抑制/阻碍：往回攥住、使发不出来
使拘束：人被这股回收之力箝住
words.recall_hint: in-（向内）+ hibit（持有）→ 往回攥住不放

words.root_logic: pro-（在前）+ hibit（持有）→ 伸手拦在前面不许过 → 禁止
words.origin: 拉丁语 prohibere（拦住、禁止），来自 pro＋habere
words.native_definition: to forbid something formally, especially by law
words.core_concept: an arm held out in front so none may pass – 一臂横在前头，谁也过不去
words.core_image: 门口那只手一横，牌子上写着不许带火进去
examples: The law prohibits smoking indoors.
Signs prohibit entry after dark.
semantic_expansions: 禁止/阻止：伸手拦在前面不许通行
words.recall_hint: pro-（在前）+ hibit（持有）→ 伸手横拦在前

words.root_logic: man（手）+ -age → 亲手把事牵住打理 → 经营、设法办成
words.origin: 意大利语 maneggiare（用手驯马、经手打理），来自拉丁语 manus（手）
words.native_definition: to be in charge of something; to succeed in doing something difficult
words.core_concept: keeping the reins in hand so the thing goes where one wants – 把缰绳握在手里，使其听使唤
words.core_image: 缰绳一紧一松，性子最烈的马也顺着走了
examples: She manages a team of twelve.
He managed to finish before the deadline.
semantic_expansions: 管理：把事牵在手里打理
设法完成/勉力应付：手上使力，硬把难事牵成
words.recall_hint: man（手）+ -age → 把缰绳握在手里打理

words.root_logic: man（手）+ -er → 上手做一件事的手法 → 方式；复数指待人的举止
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 manere，来自拉丁语 manuarius（手上的）← manus
words.native_definition: the way in which something is done; a person's way of behaving
words.core_concept: the particular way the hand goes about a thing – 那双手上手时的特定手法
words.core_image: 同一道菜，他下刀的手法和别人明显不同
examples: He answered in a friendly manner.
It is bad manners to interrupt.
semantic_expansions: 方式：上手做事的那套手法
举止/礼貌：待人时手上与身上的分寸
words.recall_hint: man（手）+ -er → 上手做事的那套手法

words.root_logic: manu（手）+ -al（…的）→ 靠手做的；名词指握在手里的那本册子
words.origin: 拉丁语 manualis（手上的、便于手持的），来自 manus
words.native_definition: done with the hands rather than by machine; a book of instructions
words.core_concept: what is worked by hand, and the book held in one – 靠手来做的，以及手上拿的那本册子
words.core_image: 机器停了，几个人挽起袖子一件件搬；旁边摊着一本翻旧的册子
examples: This is manual work, not automated.
Check the manual before you start.
semantic_expansions: 手工的/体力的：靠一双手来做的
手册：可握在手里翻的那本说明
words.recall_hint: manu（手）+ -al → 靠手做的，及手持的那本册子

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ struct（垒）+ -ion → 把材料一并垒起来这件事，及垒成之物
words.origin: 拉丁语 constructio（构筑），来自 construere（垒建）← con＋struere
words.native_definition: the act of building something, or the thing built
words.core_concept: the piling of parts together until it stands – 各部分一并垒起、直到立住
words.core_image: 脚手架一层层往上升，砖也一层层压上去
examples: The bridge is still under construction.
It is a steel construction.
semantic_expansions: 建造：把材料一并垒起的过程
建筑物/结构：垒起来立住的那个整体
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ struct（垒）+ -ion → 一并垒起、立成整体

words.root_logic: de-（向下）+ struct（垒）+ -ion → 把垒起来的一层层拆掉推倒
words.origin: 拉丁语 destructio（拆毁），来自 destruere（拆垒）← de＋struere
words.native_definition: the act of ruining something completely
words.core_concept: the pile taken back down until nothing stands – 把垒起的一层层卸到什么都不剩
words.core_image: 墙体一层层往下塌，最后只余一地碎砖
examples: The storm caused widespread destruction.
War brought the destruction of the old town.
semantic_expansions: 破坏/摧毁：把垒起之物一层层卸掉推倒
毁灭：卸到什么也不剩
words.recall_hint: de-（向下）+ struct（垒）+ -ion → 把垒起的拆到不剩

words.root_logic: in-（向内）+ struct（垒）+ -ion → 往人心里一层层垒进去 → 教导、指示
words.origin: 拉丁语 instructio（备置、教导），来自 instruere（备齐垒上）← in＋struere
words.native_definition: teaching, or a statement telling someone what to do
words.core_concept: laying knowledge in course by course inside someone – 往人里头一层层垒进去
words.core_image: 师傅一步一步讲，学徒心里的底子一层层垒实
examples: Follow the instructions on the label.
She received instruction in music.
semantic_expansions: 指示/说明：把该怎么做一层层交代进去
教导：把学问往人心里垒实
words.recall_hint: in-（向内）+ struct（垒）+ -ion → 往人心里一层层垒进去

words.root_logic: spatium（跨开的距离）→ 物之间空出的地方；引申为大气之外那片空阔
words.origin: 古法语 espace，来自拉丁语 spatium（距离、场地）
words.native_definition: an empty area available for use; the region beyond the earth's air
words.core_concept: the emptiness left open between things – 物与物之间留着的那段空
words.core_image: 两本书之间空着一指宽，正好再塞一本进去
examples: There is space for one more chair.
The rocket vanished into space.
semantic_expansions: 空间/地方：物之间空出可用的那段
太空：大气之外那片空阔无物之处
words.recall_hint: spatium（跨开的距离）→ 物之间空出的那段

words.root_logic: space（太空）+ ship（船）→ 在那片空阔里航行的船
words.origin: 英语复合词 space＋ship，20 世纪初随航天想象出现
words.native_definition: a vehicle used for travelling beyond the earth's air
words.core_concept: a vessel that sails the open emptiness – 在那片空阔里航行的船
words.core_image: 舷窗外一片漆黑，船身静静滑过没有风的地方
examples: The spaceship docked with the station.
Children drew a spaceship on the wall.
semantic_expansions: 宇宙飞船/太空船：在那片空阔里航行的船
words.recall_hint: space（那片空阔）+ ship（船）→ 在其中航行的船

words.root_logic: spac（距离）+ -ious（多…的）→ 空出的距离足够多的
words.origin: 拉丁语 spatiosus（宽阔的），来自 spatium
words.native_definition: having plenty of room inside
words.core_concept: holding a wide gap within, nothing pressing – 内里撑得开，四下不挤
words.core_image: 推门进去，四壁离得老远，脚步声都有回响
examples: The flat is bright and spacious.
They crossed a spacious hall.
semantic_expansions: 宽敞的/广阔的：内里撑开的距离足够多
words.recall_hint: spac（距离）+ -ious（多…的）→ 内里撑得开、不挤

words.root_logic: con-（加强）+ strain（拉紧）→ 四面收紧，把人限在窄处
words.origin: 古法语 constraindre，来自拉丁语 constringere（束紧）← con＋stringere
words.native_definition: to limit someone's freedom of action; to force a course
words.core_concept: cords drawn tight on every side so only one way is left – 四面收紧，只剩一条路可走
words.core_image: 四根绳同时收紧，能挪的余地只剩一寸
examples: Tight budgets constrain our choices.
He felt constrained to agree.
semantic_expansions: 限制/约束：四面收紧、余地被勒小
强迫：紧到只剩一条路可走
words.recall_hint: con-（加强）+ strain（拉紧）→ 四面收紧、只剩一条路

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ strain（拉紧）→ 往回一拽收住 → 拦住、克制
words.origin: 古法语 restraindre，来自拉丁语 restringere（拉回束住）← re＋stringere
words.native_definition: to hold someone or something back; to keep a feeling in check
words.core_concept: pulling the cord back to check something mid-motion – 往回一拽，把正要动的收住
words.core_image: 他刚要冲上去，绳子似的一只手把他往后一带
examples: Two officers restrained the man.
She restrained her anger.
semantic_expansions: 制止/拦住：往回一拽把正动的收住
克制：把自己的情绪往回收紧
words.recall_hint: re-（往回）+ strain（拉紧）→ 往回拽住收停

words.root_logic: strain（拉紧）→ 被拉紧时承的那股劲，及拉过头造成的伤
words.origin: 古法语 estreindre，来自拉丁语 stringere（拉紧）
words.native_definition: force pulling on something; pressure on a person; to injure by overstretching
words.core_concept: the pull borne by a cord stretched near its limit – 绷到将断时那根绳承着的劲
words.core_image: 绳子绷得笔直，纤维吱吱作响，眼看要断
examples: The rope broke under the strain.
He strained a muscle while lifting.
semantic_expansions: 拉力/压力：被拉紧时承着的那股劲
拉伤：拉过了头、绷出来的伤
words.recall_hint: strain（拉紧）→ 绷紧时承的劲，绷过头即伤

words.root_logic: forma（形状、模子）→ 物体的外廓；引申为定下来的规范式样，及使之成形
words.origin: 古法语 forme，来自拉丁语 forma（形状、模子）
words.native_definition: the shape of something; a printed sheet with blanks to fill; to bring into shape
words.core_concept: the outline a thing settles into – 事物定下来的那个外廓
words.core_image: 泥坯在轮盘上转，手一收，边缘就定住了
examples: The lake has the form of a crescent.
Please fill in this form and sign it.
semantic_expansions: 形状/形式：事物定下来的那个外廓
表格：把要填之项定成规范式样的那张纸
words.recall_hint: forma（形状、模子）→ 定下来的外廓与式样

words.root_logic: forma（最先的）+ -er（比较）→ 两者之中在先的那个
words.origin: 中古英语 formere，来自古英语 forma（最先的）；与 forma（形状）同形，此处取「最先」一支
words.native_definition: of an earlier time; the first of two things mentioned
words.core_concept: the one standing earlier in the line of two – 两者并列时在先的那个
words.core_image: 两个名字并排写着，手指点住上面那个
examples: Her former employer wrote the reference.
Of the two routes, the former is shorter.
semantic_expansions: 以前的/前者的：两者并列时处在先的那个
words.recall_hint: forma（最先的）+ -er → 两者中在先的那个

words.root_logic: per-（彻底）+ form（成形）+ -ance → 把一件事彻底做成形 → 当众做完的一场，及成效
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 parfourmance，来自 parfournir（彻底完成）← per＋fournir，后受 form 影响改拼
words.native_definition: an act of presenting a play or music before an audience; how well someone does something
words.core_concept: carrying a thing through until it stands fully formed – 把一件事一路做到彻底成形
words.core_image: 幕布拉开，她把整支曲子一气走完
examples: The evening performance starts at eight.
His performance at work has improved.
semantic_expansions: 表演/演出：当众把一件事彻底做成形的那一场
表现：把事做到什么成形程度，即成效
words.recall_hint: per-（彻底）+ form（成形）→ 彻底做成形的一场与其成效

words.root_logic: portus（港、门道）与 portare（运送）同族 → 货物由船转陆的那个口
words.origin: 拉丁语 portus（港口、门道），与 portare（运送）同族
words.native_definition: a town or place where ships load and unload
words.core_concept: the mouth where goods pass between ship and shore – 货物在船与岸之间过渡的那个口
words.core_image: 吊臂起落，成箱货物从船舷转到岸上
examples: The ship reached port before dawn.
Grain is shipped through this port.
semantic_expansions: 港口/口岸：货物在船与岸之间过渡的那个口
words.recall_hint: portus（港、门道）→ 货物由船转陆的那个口

words.root_logic: edere（交出、发布）→ 为交出去而先把文字勾划整治一遍
words.origin: 英语 edit 由 editor 反向构词而来，源头是拉丁语 edere（交出、发表）
words.native_definition: to prepare written work for publication by correcting and cutting it
words.core_concept: working over a text so it is fit to be handed out – 把文字整治到可以交出去的程度
words.core_image: 红笔在稿子上圈掉一段，又在空白处补了两行
examples: She edits a weekly magazine.
He edited the footage down to ten minutes.
semantic_expansions: 编辑/校订：为交出去而整治文字
剪辑：把影像同样整治成可交出的一版
words.recall_hint: edere（交出）→ 为交出去而先整治一遍

words.root_logic: edit（整治交出）+ -or（人）→ 负责整治并定稿交出的人
words.origin: 拉丁语 editor（交出者、发表者），来自 edere
words.native_definition: a person who prepares and decides the content of a publication
words.core_concept: the one who works a text over and decides it may go out – 把稿子整治定稿、点头放行的人
words.core_image: 他把最后一页放下，签了字，稿子这才准许送印
examples: The editor rejected the article.
She is editor of the local paper.
semantic_expansions: 编辑/主编：整治稿件并定稿放行的人
words.recall_hint: edit（整治交出）+ -or（人）→ 定稿放行的那个人

words.root_logic: editor（定稿人）+ -ial（…的）→ 属于定稿人立场的；名词指报社表态的那篇
words.origin: 英语 editorial，来自 editor ← 拉丁语 edere
words.native_definition: relating to the editing of a publication; an article giving a paper's opinion
words.core_concept: belonging to the one who decides what goes out – 属于那位定稿放行者的
words.core_image: 头版下方那一栏不署名，说的是整家报社的立场
examples: She joined the editorial team.
The paper ran an editorial on the strike.
semantic_expansions: 编辑的：属于定稿放行者职务的
社论：由定稿方出面表态的那一篇
words.recall_hint: editor（定稿人）+ -ial → 属于定稿放行者的

words.root_logic: edere（交出、发布）+ -ition → 一次交出去的那一批，即某一版
words.origin: 拉丁语 editio（发表、发行），来自 edere（交出）
words.native_definition: a particular issue or version of a book, paper, or broadcast
words.core_concept: one batch as it was given out that time – 那一回交出去的那一批
words.core_image: 扉页上印着第三回付印的字样，内容与头一回已有出入
examples: This is the second edition of the book.
The evening edition sold out.
semantic_expansions: 版本/版次：某一回交出去的那一批
一期：报刊按次交出的其中一份
words.recall_hint: edere（交出）+ -ition → 一次交出去的那一批

words.root_logic: at-（ad- 靠向）+ tain（触及）→ 一路伸手过去，终于够到
words.origin: 古法语 ataindre，来自拉丁语 attingere（触及）← ad＋tangere（触）；英语拼作 -tain 受 contain/obtain 类推影响，词源仍在 tangere 一支
words.native_definition: to succeed in reaching or achieving something after effort
words.core_concept: stretching until the fingers finally close on it – 一直伸，直到指尖终于搭上
words.core_image: 指尖一寸寸往上探，最后扣住了崖顶那道边沿
examples: She attained the rank of captain.
Few attain such skill so young.
semantic_expansions: 达到/实现：一路伸手过去终于够到
获得：够到之后归入自己手里
words.recall_hint: at-（靠向）+ tain（触及）→ 伸手过去终于够到

words.root_logic: im-（in- 使）+ pair（更坏）→ 使某物比原先更差 → 损害
words.origin: 古法语 empeirier，来自晚期拉丁语 impejorare（使变坏）← in＋peior（更坏）；与 pair（一对，来自 par 相等）不同源
words.native_definition: to weaken or damage something, especially a faculty or ability
words.core_concept: knocking a sound thing down a notch so it works less well – 把本来好的磕掉一层，从此不如原先
words.core_image: 完好的板面被磕出一道缺口，再用就总差着那一点
examples: Loud noise can impair your hearing.
Fatigue impaired his judgement.
semantic_expansions: 损害/削弱：把本来好的弄差一层
使受损：功能被磕缺后不如原先
words.recall_hint: im-（使）+ pair（更坏）→ 使之比原先更差

words.root_logic: influenza 的截短：in-（进入）+ flu（流）→ 流进体内的那股病气
words.origin: 英语 flu 是意大利语 influenza 的截短形；influenza ← 拉丁语 influentia ← influere（in＋fluere 流入），旧时以为疾病由星辰之气「流入」人身
words.native_definition: a common illness caused by a virus, with fever and aching
words.core_concept: the sickness once thought to flow into the body from outside – 旧时认为自外流进体内的那股病气
words.core_image: 一屋子人接连倒下，像有什么顺着空气淌进了身体
examples: She caught the flu last winter.
Half the office is off with flu.
semantic_expansions: 流感/流行性感冒：旧说自外流进体内的那股病气
words.recall_hint: influenza 截短 → in-（进入）+ flu（流）→ 流进体内的病气

words.root_logic: premere（压、按）→ 用力压下去；引申为压印出版的那一行，即报界
words.origin: 古法语 presser，来自拉丁语 pressare ← premere（压、按）
words.native_definition: to push firmly on something; also newspapers and journalists collectively
words.core_concept: bearing down on a thing with steady force – 稳稳使力压在物上
words.core_image: 掌根压在纸面上，油墨透过版子印了上去；报馆的机器整夜这样压着
examples: Press the button to start.
The press gathered outside the court.
semantic_expansions: 按/压：稳稳使力压在物上
报界/新闻界：靠压印机器出版的那一行
words.recall_hint: premere（压、按）→ 使力压下；压印成版即报界

words.root_logic: scribere（写、刻画）的过去分词 scriptum → 写下来的那份文字
words.origin: 拉丁语 scriptum（写成之物），scribere（写）的过去分词中性形
words.native_definition: the written text of a play or film; a system of writing
words.core_concept: the thing as it stands written down – 已经写下来、定在纸面上的那份
words.core_image: 演员手里那几页纸被翻得起了毛边，台词全在上面
examples: He is writing a film script.
The inscription uses an ancient script.
semantic_expansions: 剧本/脚本：写下来供照着演的那份文字
字体：文字写下来所用的那套形体
words.recall_hint: scribere（写）的过去分词 → 已写下定在纸面的那份

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ fer（带）+ -ence → 把话头带回某处去 → 提及、依据
words.origin: 英语 reference 来自 refer ← 拉丁语 referre（带回、归于）← re＋ferre（带）
words.native_definition: a mention of something; a source consulted; a letter about someone's ability
words.core_concept: carrying the matter back to the place it came from – 把话头带回它的出处
words.core_image: 他讲到一半停下，翻回书后那一栏，指着出处给人看
examples: She made no reference to the delay.
Please list your references at the end.
semantic_expansions: 提及：把话头带到某处
参考：把话头带回出处去核对
推荐信：把某人来历带回给对方看的那封
words.recall_hint: re-（回）+ fer（带）→ 把话头带回它的出处

words.root_logic: leg（法条）+ -al（…的）→ 属于成文法的、法条许可的
words.origin: 拉丁语 legalis（属于法的），来自 lex/legis（法条）
words.native_definition: relating to the law; allowed by the law
words.core_concept: standing on the side the statute allows – 站在条文许可的那一边
words.core_image: 翻到条文那一页，指着其中一行说这样办没问题
examples: She sought legal advice at once.
It is legal to park here on Sundays.
semantic_expansions: 法律的：属于成文法条的
合法的：落在条文许可那一边的
words.recall_hint: leg（法条）+ -al → 属于成文法、为条文所许

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ leg（依法委派）+ -ate → 依法把职权往下交给人 → 委派
words.origin: 拉丁语 delegare（委派、转交），来自 de＋legare（依法交付）← lex
words.native_definition: to give a task or authority to someone else; a person sent to represent others
words.core_concept: handing one's warrant down to another to act on it – 把自己那份凭据往下交给人去行使
words.core_image: 他在名册上点了一个人，把盖印的文书交到那人手里
examples: A good manager knows how to delegate.
Each branch sent two delegates.
semantic_expansions: 委派/授权：依法把职权往下交出
代表：受此委派、代人出面的那个人
words.recall_hint: de-（往下）+ leg（依法委派）→ 把凭据往下交给人

words.root_logic: leg（立遗嘱交付）+ -acy → 依遗嘱交下来的东西 → 遗赠，引申为前人留下的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 legatia（遗赠），来自 legare（立遗嘱交付）← lex（法）
words.native_definition: money or property left in a will; something handed down from the past
words.core_concept: what a warrant hands on after its holder is gone – 立据人身后依据文书交下来的东西
words.core_image: 老人过世后，铁盒里的文书按写明的那样一件件交到后人手上
examples: He left a small legacy to the school.
The war left a legacy of mistrust.
semantic_expansions: 遗产/遗赠：依文书身后交下来的东西
遗留：前人手里传下来的那一份
words.recall_hint: leg（立遗嘱交付）+ -acy → 依文书交下来的东西

words.root_logic: ob-（朝向）+ lig（绑）+ -ation → 被绑在某事上、不得不做的那份
words.origin: 拉丁语 obligatio（束缚、义务），来自 obligare（绑住）← ob＋ligare
words.native_definition: something one is bound to do, by duty or by law
words.core_concept: the cord tying one to a task one cannot walk away from – 把人系在某事上、走不开的那根绳
words.core_image: 手腕上那圈绳一头系在事上，脚步再急也带着它
examples: He has a legal obligation to pay.
She felt no obligation to reply.
semantic_expansions: 义务/责任：被系在某事上、非做不可的那份
约束：那根绳本身的拉力
words.recall_hint: ob-（朝向）+ lig（绑）→ 被系在某事上走不开

words.root_logic: re-（再、牢）+ lig（绑）+ -ion → 把人反复系向神明的那套联结
words.origin: 拉丁语 religio（虔敬、戒律），一说来自 religare（牢牢系住）← re＋ligare
words.native_definition: belief in and worship of a god or gods, with its practices
words.core_concept: the cord that ties a people back to what they hold sacred – 把人一再系回所敬之物的那根绳
words.core_image: 众人依着同一套誓约聚在一处，绳结般彼此系住
examples: Religion shapes much of the local custom.
She studies comparative religion.
semantic_expansions: 宗教/信仰：把人一再系向所敬之物的那套联结
words.recall_hint: re-（牢）+ lig（绑）→ 把人一再系回所敬之物

words.root_logic: religion（联结）+ -ous（…的）→ 属于那套联结的；引申为一丝不苟
words.origin: 拉丁语 religiosus（虔敬的、谨守的），来自 religio
words.native_definition: relating to religion; believing strongly; done with scrupulous care
words.core_concept: holding to the cord without letting it slack – 攥着那根绳不让它松
words.core_image: 他每日照着同一套仪节做，一次也没落下
examples: He comes from a religious family.
She keeps religious records of every payment.
semantic_expansions: 宗教的：属于那套联结的
虔诚的：攥住绳子不放松
严谨的：同样这份不肯松的劲用在做事上
words.recall_hint: religion（联结）+ -ous → 攥着那根绳不放松

words.root_logic: proprius（专属的）→ 正是这一个该有的样子 → 恰当、合规矩
words.origin: 古法语 propre，来自拉丁语 proprius（自己的、专属的）
words.native_definition: right, suitable, or correct for the situation
words.core_concept: the one form that fits this case and no other – 只有这一种才对得上这场合
words.core_image: 钥匙插进去一转就开，别的哪一把都对不上这个孔
examples: Use the proper tool for the job.
That is not the proper way to ask.
semantic_expansions: 适当的/正确的：正是这场合专该有的那一种
真正的：名实相符、对得上的
words.recall_hint: proprius（专属的）→ 正对得上这场合的那一种

words.root_logic: propr（自己的）+ -ty → 归自己名下之物；也指物本身专有的性状
words.origin: 古法语 propriete，来自拉丁语 proprietas（所有权、特性）← proprius
words.native_definition: a thing owned; land and buildings; a quality belonging to something
words.core_concept: what stands under one's own name, or a trait belonging to a thing alone – 记在自己名下之物，或某物独有的性状
words.core_image: 文书上写明这几间屋归他名下；铁遇火会红，这是铁自带的脾性
examples: All his property passed to his son.
Salt has the property of preserving food.
semantic_expansions: 财产/房产：记在自己名下之物
特性：某物专有、别物没有的性状
words.recall_hint: propr（自己的）+ -ty → 归自己名下之物，及物自带的性状

words.root_logic: exter（外）+ -ior（对照级）→ 两边相比更靠外的那一面
words.origin: 拉丁语 exterior（较外的），exterus（在外的）的比较级
words.native_definition: the outer surface or appearance of something
words.core_concept: the further-out of the two faces – 里外一比，更靠外的那一面
words.core_image: 手掌沿墙抹过去，摸到的是朝着风雨的那一面
examples: The exterior walls need painting.
Beneath his calm exterior he was furious.
semantic_expansions: 外部的/外表：里外相比更靠外的那一面
words.recall_hint: exter（外）+ -ior（对照级）→ 更靠外的那一面

words.root_logic: inter（内）+ -ior（对照级）→ 两边相比更靠里的那一面
words.origin: 拉丁语 interior（较内的），interus（在内的）的比较级
words.native_definition: the inside part of something; the inland part of a country
words.core_concept: the further-in of the two faces – 里外一比，更靠里的那一面
words.core_image: 推门进去，脚步声在四壁之间来回撞
examples: The car has a leather interior.
They travelled into the interior.
semantic_expansions: 内部的/内部：里外相比更靠里的那一面
内地：一国之中更靠里、离海更远的那片
words.recall_hint: inter（内）+ -ior（对照级）→ 更靠里的那一面

words.root_logic: deterior（更差，比较级）+ -ate（使/变）→ 一路往更差那头去
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 deteriorare（使变坏），来自 deterior（较差的，de- 的比较级）
words.native_definition: to become progressively worse
words.core_concept: sliding step by step toward the worse of the two – 一步步滑向两者中更差那一头
words.core_image: 墙面一年比一年斑驳，去年补的那块今年又鼓起来
examples: Her health deteriorated over the winter.
Relations between them deteriorated fast.
semantic_expansions: 恶化/变坏：一路滑向更差那一头
退化：同一方向上功能一路走低
words.recall_hint: deterior（更差）+ -ate → 往更差那头一路去

words.root_logic: mod（量度）+ -er- + -ate → 守在刻线之内的 → 不过火
words.origin: 拉丁语 moderatus（有节制的），moderare（节制）的过去分词 ← modus
words.native_definition: average in amount or degree; not extreme
words.core_concept: staying inside the line, never brimming over – 停在刻线之内，不满溢出来
words.core_image: 水倒到刻线就收手，杯子没溢也不见底
examples: Take moderate exercise every day.
He holds moderate political views.
semantic_expansions: 适度的/中等的：停在刻线之内、不过量
温和的：主张同样不走极端
words.recall_hint: mod（量度）+ -ate → 守在刻线之内、不过火

words.root_logic: mod（量度）+ -ify（使…）→ 把尺度调一调 → 修改、使缓和
words.origin: 拉丁语 modificare（限定、调整），来自 modus＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: to change something slightly, especially to improve it
words.core_concept: shifting the line a little rather than remaking the vessel – 把那道刻线挪一点，而非另造一只杯
words.core_image: 把刻线往下挪了半分，别处一概没动
examples: They modified the design slightly.
She modified her tone when he objected.
semantic_expansions: 修改/调整：把尺度挪动一点
使缓和：把话或态度的分寸往回收一点
words.recall_hint: mod（量度）+ -ify → 把那道刻线挪一点

words.root_logic: com-（合）+ mod（量度）+ -ity → 合于尺度、便于计量买卖之物
words.origin: 拉丁语 commoditas（便利、合宜），来自 commodus（合尺度的）← com＋modus
words.native_definition: a thing bought and sold, especially a basic good
words.core_concept: goods cut to a common measure so they can be traded – 按公认尺度计量、可拿去交易之物
words.core_image: 秤上一斤一斤过，按同一把尺子记价开单
examples: Coffee is a global commodity.
Water became a scarce commodity.
semantic_expansions: 商品/日用品：按公认尺度计量、可供买卖之物
words.recall_hint: com-（合）+ mod（量度）→ 合于尺度、可计量买卖之物

words.root_logic: qual（何种性质）+ -ity → 是什么成色 → 品质；也指人身上的特质
words.origin: 拉丁语 qualitas（性质、属性），来自 qualis（何种）
words.native_definition: how good something is; a feature someone or something has
words.core_concept: what kind a thing turns out to be when looked at closely – 细看之下，它到底是什么成色
words.core_image: 对着光看那块料，纹理密实，一眼便知与别的不同
examples: The quality of the cloth is excellent.
Patience is her best quality.
semantic_expansions: 质量/品质：细看之下是什么成色
特质：人或物身上那一样别处没有的性质
words.recall_hint: qual（何种性质）+ -ity → 到底是什么成色

words.root_logic: qual（何种性质）+ -ify（使…）→ 使成色够得上 → 具备资格；也指给话加限定
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 qualificare（定其性质），来自 qualis＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: to reach the required standard; to limit a statement
words.core_concept: coming up to the mark that the kind requires – 成色达到那一档所要求的线
words.core_image: 料子送去过筛，够得上那道线的才盖印放行
examples: She qualified as a doctor last year.
He qualified his praise with one caution.
semantic_expansions: 取得资格/合格：成色够上所要求那道线
限定：给话加一道界线，缩住它的适用范围
words.recall_hint: qual（何种性质）+ -ify → 使成色够上那道线

words.root_logic: qualify（使够格）+ -ation → 够格这件事，及作凭据的那纸；也指附加的限定
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 qualificatio，来自 qualificare
words.native_definition: an official record of passing an exam; a skill making one suitable; a limiting remark
words.core_concept: the proof that one came up to the mark, or the limit set on a claim – 够上那道线的凭据，或给话加的那道界
words.core_image: 抽屉里那张盖了印的纸，写明他过了那道线
examples: She has a teaching qualification.
He agreed, with one qualification.
semantic_expansions: 资格/学历：够上那道线的凭据
限定条件：给话加的那道界
words.recall_hint: qualify（使够格）+ -ation → 够格的凭据，或所加的那道界

words.root_logic: pro-（按照）+ portio（份）→ 按份切分后各占的那一份 → 比例
words.origin: 拉丁语 proportio（比例），来自 pro portione（按份而言）；portio（份）与 pars/partis（部分）同源，故归 pars 一族
words.native_definition: a part considered in relation to the whole; the right relation between parts
words.core_concept: how large a share one piece takes of the whole – 一块在整体里占多大的一份
words.core_image: 圆饼切开，每人手里那块占整张多大，一眼比得出来
examples: A large proportion of the class agreed.
The columns are pleasing in proportion.
semantic_expansions: 比例：一份占整体多大
部分：切出来的那一份本身
均衡：各份之间大小相称
words.recall_hint: pro-（按照）+ portio（份）→ 各占整体的那一份

words.root_logic: in-（落到…上）+ cid（落下）+ -ent → 落到日常里头的那一桩
words.origin: 拉丁语 incidens（落在上头的），来自 incidere ← in＋cadere（落下）
words.native_definition: an event, especially an unpleasant or unusual one
words.core_concept: the one thing that came down into an otherwise plain day – 落进平常日子里的那一桩
words.core_image: 路当中忽然砸下一样东西，行人全停下来看
examples: The incident was reported to the police.
No one was hurt in the incident.
semantic_expansions: 事件/事变：落进平常日子里的那一桩
words.recall_hint: in-（落到上）+ cid（落下）→ 落进日子里的那一桩

words.root_logic: incident（落下之事）+ -ence → 落下来的频密程度 → 发生的多寡
words.origin: 拉丁语 incidentia，来自 incidere（落到上头）
words.native_definition: the rate at which something happens, especially something unwanted
words.core_concept: how thickly such fallings come down over a stretch – 一段里头落下多密
words.core_image: 雨点打在窗台上，一阵密一阵疏，数得出快慢
examples: The incidence of the disease has fallen.
There is a high incidence of theft here.
semantic_expansions: 发生率/发生频率：这类事落下来的密度
words.recall_hint: incident（落下之事）+ -ence → 落下来有多密

words.root_logic: incidental（顺带落下的）+ -ly → 顺着话头落下来一句 → 顺便说
words.origin: 英语 incidentally，来自 incidental ← incident
words.native_definition: used to add a remark not connected to the main point
words.core_concept: a word that drops in alongside, not the thing one came to say – 顺着旁边落下来的一句，不是正题
words.core_image: 话说到一半，他顺口带出一句不相干的
examples: Incidentally, I saw her yesterday.
The two met quite incidentally.
semantic_expansions: 顺便说：顺着话头旁落下来的一句
偶然地：不是安排好、恰巧落下的
words.recall_hint: incidental（顺带落下）+ -ly → 顺着旁边落下一句

words.root_logic: kyklos（圆圈）→ 转回原处的一整圈 → 周期；也指骑那两个轮子
words.origin: 拉丁语 cyclus，来自希腊语 kyklos（圆圈、轮）
words.native_definition: a set of events repeating in the same order; to ride a bicycle
words.core_concept: one full turn that ends where it started – 转满一圈、终点又是起点
words.core_image: 四季走一遍，又回到落第一场雪的那几天
examples: The washing machine has a short cycle.
She cycles to work every day.
semantic_expansions: 周期/循环：转满一圈又回到起点
骑车：踩着轮子转圈前行
words.recall_hint: kyklos（圆圈）→ 转回原处的一整圈

words.root_logic: bi-（二）+ cycl（轮）+ -e → 两个轮子的车
words.origin: 法语 bicycle，由拉丁 bi-（二）＋希腊 kyklos（轮）合成，19 世纪造词
words.native_definition: a vehicle with two wheels that one pedals
words.core_concept: the frame that rides on two turning circles – 架在两个转圈之物上的车
words.core_image: 前后两个圈一齐转起来，人就跟着往前走
examples: He rode his bicycle to school.
Her bicycle has a broken chain.
semantic_expansions: 自行车/脚踏车：架在两个转圈之物上的车
words.recall_hint: bi-（二）+ cycl（轮）→ 两个轮子的车

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ cycl（转一圈）+ -e → 让它再转一圈回来 → 回收再用
words.origin: 英语 recycle，由 re-＋cycle 合成，20 世纪随环保用语普及
words.native_definition: to treat used material so it can be used again
words.core_concept: sending a thing round the loop once more instead of dropping it – 让用过之物再走一圈回来，而不是丢掉
words.core_image: 旧瓶子送回炉里，出来时又是一只能用的
examples: We recycle paper and glass at home.
These bottles can be recycled.
semantic_expansions: 回收/再利用：让用过之物再转一圈回来
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ cycl（转圈）→ 让它再走一圈回来

words.root_logic: largus（宽绰有余）→ 体量占得开、不局促
words.origin: 古法语 large，来自拉丁语 largus（丰足的、宽绰的）
words.native_definition: of considerable size or extent
words.core_concept: taking up room with margin left over – 占得开、周围还留着余地
words.core_image: 两臂张开也抱不住那截树身
examples: They live in a large house.
A large number of people came.
semantic_expansions: 大的/大量的：占得开、有余裕而不局促
words.recall_hint: largus（宽绰有余）→ 占得开、不局促

words.root_logic: en-（使…）+ large（宽绰）→ 使它占得更开 → 扩大、放大
words.origin: 古法语 enlargier（放宽），由 en-＋large ← 拉丁语 largus
words.native_definition: to make something bigger, or to become bigger
words.core_concept: pushing the edges out so there is more room within – 把边往外推，里头就更宽绰
words.core_image: 照片一角被拉到满幅，原先看不清的纹路露了出来
examples: They plan to enlarge the kitchen.
Please enlarge this photograph.
semantic_expansions: 扩大/放大/增大：把边往外推、使更宽绰
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ large（宽绰）→ 把边往外推

words.root_logic: large（大部分）+ -ly → 占着大头地 → 主要、多半
words.origin: 英语 largely，来自 large 加副词后缀 -ly
words.native_definition: mostly; to a great extent
words.core_concept: the side that takes up most of the whole – 占了整体大头的那一边
words.core_image: 天平一头压得低低的，另一头只剩一点
examples: The project was largely successful.
His account is largely accurate.
semantic_expansions: 主要地/大部分/多半：占着整体大头的那一边
words.recall_hint: large（大部分）+ -ly → 占着大头地

words.root_logic: maior（更大的）→ 相比之下更要紧的；名词指主修的那一门
words.origin: 拉丁语 maior（更大的），magnus（大）的比较级
words.native_definition: greater in size or importance; a student's main subject
words.core_concept: the thicker branch the others hang off – 别的枝都挂在它上头的那一根
words.core_image: 顺着树身往上看，最粗那根撑住了大半个树冠
examples: This is a major problem for us.
She chose history as her major.
semantic_expansions: 主要的/重大的：相比之下更大更要紧的那一方
专业：所修各门里作主干的那一门
words.recall_hint: maior（更大的）→ 别的都挂在它上头的那一根

words.root_logic: major（更大的）+ -ity → 更大的那一部分 → 多数
words.origin: 法语 majorité，来自中世纪拉丁语 maioritas ← maior
words.native_definition: the greater number or part of a group
words.core_concept: the side that has the greater count – 数下来更多的那一边
words.core_image: 举手一数，一边的手明显比另一边密
examples: The majority voted in favour.
A majority of students agreed.
semantic_expansions: 大多数/多数：数下来更多的那一边
words.recall_hint: major（更大的）+ -ity → 数下来更多那一边

words.root_logic: maior（更大）→ maiestas（尊大）→ 令人仰视的气派；亦作君主尊称
words.origin: 古法语 majeste，来自拉丁语 maiestas（威严、尊大）← maior
words.native_definition: impressive dignity or grandeur; a title for a king or queen
words.core_concept: the bearing of one seated higher than all present – 坐得比在场所有人都高的那份气派
words.core_image: 台阶尽头那个座位高出一截，底下的人都得抬头看
examples: The mountains rose in silent majesty.
Her Majesty will arrive at noon.
semantic_expansions: 威严/壮丽：令人须仰视的那份气派
陛下：以此气派作君主的尊称
words.recall_hint: maior（更大）→ maiestas（尊大）→ 令人仰视的气派

words.root_logic: numer（数目）+ -ous（多…的）→ 数目多的
words.origin: 拉丁语 numerosus（数目多的），来自 numerus（数目）
words.native_definition: existing in great numbers; many
words.core_concept: so many that the counting runs long – 点起来要数好一阵
words.core_image: 屋檐下的燕子一排接一排，数到后头就乱了
examples: She has numerous friends abroad.
We met on numerous occasions.
semantic_expansions: 许多的/众多的：数目多、点起来要数好一阵
words.recall_hint: numer（数目）+ -ous（多…的）→ 数目多的

words.root_logic: numer（数目）+ -ical（…的）→ 用数目表示的、按数计的
words.origin: 英语 numerical，来自中世纪拉丁语 numericus ← numerus
words.native_definition: expressed in numbers; relating to numbers
words.core_concept: set down as counts rather than words – 记成数目而非文字
words.core_image: 表格里每一栏都换成了阿拉伯记号，一列列排下去
examples: Put the files in numerical order.
The numerical results agree with theory.
semantic_expansions: 数字的/数值的：以数目记下、按数计的
words.recall_hint: numer（数目）+ -ical → 以数目记下的

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ numer（数）+ -able（可…的）→ 数不过来的
words.origin: 拉丁语 innumerabilis（数不清的），来自 in-＋numerare（计数）← numerus
words.native_definition: too many to be counted
words.core_concept: more than the fingers can keep up with – 手指跟不上、点不完
words.core_image: 沙从指缝里漏下去，颗数根本跟不上
examples: He made innumerable attempts.
Innumerable stars filled the sky.
semantic_expansions: 数不清的/无数的：多到点不过来
words.recall_hint: in-（不）+ numer（数）+ -able → 数不过来的

words.root_logic: apo-（离开、退开）+ log（说辞）→ 退一步把话说开 → 认过的说辞
words.origin: 希腊语 apologia（辩解、答辩），来自 apo（离）＋logos（话语）
words.native_definition: a statement saying one is sorry for a fault
words.core_concept: stepping back and putting the fault into words – 退一步，把自己的不是说出口
words.core_image: 他往后退了半步，把话头接过来，承认是自己没办好
examples: He offered a sincere apology.
She made no apology for her view.
semantic_expansions: 道歉/歉意：退一步把自己的不是说出口
辩解：同样是把话说开，为自己申说
words.recall_hint: apo-（退开）+ log（说辞）→ 退一步把话说开

words.root_logic: apology（认过的说辞）+ -ise（使、行）→ 把那番话说出来
words.origin: 希腊语 apologizesthai（申说），来自 apologia ← apo＋logos
words.native_definition: to say that one is sorry for a fault
words.core_concept: putting the stepping-back into actual words – 把那退一步的意思真说出口
words.core_image: 他站起来，当着众人把那句话讲了出来
examples: He apologised for being late.
She refused to apologise.
semantic_expansions: 道歉/认错：把退一步认过的话说出口
words.recall_hint: apology（认过说辞）+ -ise → 把那番话说出口

words.root_logic: bio-（生命）+ -logy（条理、学科）→ 讲清生命之理的那门学问
words.origin: 希腊语 bios（生命）＋logos（条理）合成，19 世纪造词
words.native_definition: the scientific study of living things
words.core_concept: the account given of how living things work – 把活物的道理说清的那一套
words.core_image: 从一片叶脉讲到血液怎么走，条理一路排下来
examples: She teaches biology at the college.
Marine biology is his field.
semantic_expansions: 生物学：把活物的道理说出条理的那门学问
words.recall_hint: bio-（生命）+ -logy（条理）→ 讲清生命之理的学问

words.root_logic: positum（被放置的）→ 沿路安置的驿站 → 邮政；被安置的位子 → 职位
words.origin: 古法语 poste，来自意大利语 posta ← 拉丁语 posita/ponere（放置）；驿站本义是「沿途置马之处」。门柱义的 post 另出拉丁 postis，不在此族
words.native_definition: the system that carries letters; a job or official position
words.core_concept: a station set along the way, and by extension a place one is set in – 沿途安置的那一站，引申为人被安在的位子
words.core_image: 沿路每隔一程设一处，换马换人，信件一路递下去
examples: Send it by post, not by email.
She applied for a teaching post.
semantic_expansions: 邮政/邮件：靠沿途置站接力递送的那套
职位：人被安置进去的那个位子
words.recall_hint: positum（被放置的）→ 沿途置站 → 邮政；被安的位子 → 职位

words.root_logic: post（驿站接力）+ -age（费用）→ 走这套接力所付的钱
words.origin: 英语 postage，由 post ← 拉丁语 ponere（放置）加 -age 构成
words.native_definition: the money charged for sending something by post
words.core_concept: what one pays for the relay of stations to carry it – 为那套接力递送付的钱
words.core_image: 柜台上称过重量，贴上几枚小纸片才收下
examples: Postage costs have gone up again.
The price includes postage.
semantic_expansions: 邮费/邮资：为沿途接力递送所付的钱
words.recall_hint: post（驿站接力）+ -age（费用）→ 走这套递送付的钱

words.root_logic: positura（放置的样子）→ 身体摆放的姿态
words.origin: 法语 posture，来自意大利语 postura ← 拉丁语 positura（安放、位置）← ponere
words.native_definition: the way a person holds their body; an attitude taken up
words.core_concept: how the body is set and held in place – 身体被摆放、端住的那个样子
words.core_image: 他把背挺直、肩往后收，整个人的架子就稳住了
examples: Good posture prevents back pain.
The country took a defensive posture.
semantic_expansions: 姿势/体态：身体摆放端住的那个样子
姿态：对外摆出的那副架势
words.recall_hint: positura（放置的样子）→ 身体摆放端住的样子

words.root_logic: friskaz（未腐、不咸）→ 还保着刚来时那副样子
words.origin: 古英语 fersc（不咸的、未腐的），来自原始日耳曼语 *friskaz
words.native_definition: newly made or obtained; not stale; not salty
words.core_concept: keeping the state it had at the very start – 还守着刚出来时那个状态
words.core_image: 刚出炉的那一块掰开，热气往上冒
examples: Buy fresh bread every morning.
She went out for some fresh air.
semantic_expansions: 新鲜的：还是刚出来时那个样子
清新的：气息不闷不浊
淡水的：不带盐味的那种水
words.recall_hint: friskaz（未腐、不咸）→ 还守着刚来时的状态

words.root_logic: re-（重新）+ fresh（未走味）→ 把那副刚来时的样子找回来
words.origin: 古法语 refreschier（使变凉爽），由 re-＋fresche ← 法兰克语，同出 *friskaz
words.native_definition: to make someone feel less tired; to update something
words.core_concept: bringing a thing back to the state it started in – 把它拉回刚出来时那个状态
words.core_image: 洗过脸再坐下，人像换了一个
examples: A cold drink will refresh you.
Refresh the page to see the change.
semantic_expansions: 使恢复精神：把人拉回刚开始时那股劲
刷新：把画面拉回最新那一版
words.recall_hint: re-（重新）+ fresh（未走味）→ 拉回刚来时的状态

words.root_logic: refresh（使恢复）+ -ment → 使人回过劲来的那份东西
words.origin: 古法语 refreschissement，来自 refreschier ← 同出 *friskaz
words.native_definition: a light snack or drink; the act of making one feel less tired
words.core_concept: the small thing taken to get one's edge back – 拿来把劲头找回来的那一点东西
words.core_image: 半路歇脚，喝下那一杯，脚步又轻了
examples: Refreshments will be served at noon.
He paused for refreshment.
semantic_expansions: 点心/饮料：拿来把劲头找回的那点东西
恢复精神：找回劲头这件事本身
words.recall_hint: refresh（使恢复）+ -ment → 把劲头找回的那份东西

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ gard（看守）→ 再把目光投过去 → 看待；引申为敬重、问候
words.origin: 古法语 regarder（注视），由 re-＋garder（看守）← 法兰克语 *wardon
words.native_definition: to think of someone in a particular way; respect; greetings
words.core_concept: turning the eyes back onto a thing and holding a view of it – 把目光再投回去，并就此存下一个看法
words.core_image: 他把灯又转回那一处，端端地照了好一会儿
examples: She is regarded as an expert.
Give my regards to your parents.
semantic_expansions: 看待/认为：把目光投过去并存下一个看法
尊重：目光里带着分量
问候：把这份目光托人带过去
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ gard（看守）→ 再把目光投过去

words.root_logic: regard（投目看待）的分词转介词 → 目光所对着的那件事
words.origin: 英语 regarding，regard 的现在分词转作介词
words.native_definition: about; concerning a particular matter
words.core_concept: pointing at the very thing the eyes are turned on – 直指目光正对着的那一桩
words.core_image: 灯光圈住的就是要谈的那一处，旁的都在暗里
examples: I wrote to him regarding the delay.
Regarding costs, we need more data.
semantic_expansions: 关于/至于：目光正对着的那一桩事
words.recall_hint: regard（投目）+ -ing → 目光所对着的那件事

words.root_logic: regard（投目留意）+ -less（无…）→ 不往那边看 → 不顾、照样做
words.origin: 英语 regardless，由 regard＋-less（缺乏）构成
words.native_definition: without paying attention to something; anyway
words.core_concept: walking on without turning the eyes to what stands there – 眼睛不往那边转，照样往前走
words.core_image: 旁边有人喊他，他连头都没偏，脚步没停
examples: He went ahead regardless of the risk.
We must finish it regardless.
semantic_expansions: 不顾/不管：目光不往那边转
无论如何：不管那边有什么，照样进行
words.recall_hint: regard（投目留意）+ -less（无）→ 不往那边看，照样走

words.root_logic: regul（直尺）+ -ar（…的）→ 合着尺子来的 → 匀齐、按时
words.origin: 拉丁语 regularis（合于准尺的），来自 regula（直尺）
words.native_definition: happening at even intervals; usual; evenly shaped
words.core_concept: coming out even because each was laid to the same rod – 每一个都照同一把尺来，故彼此齐整
words.core_image: 砖缝一道道对齐，间距都照同一把尺量过
examples: He is a regular customer here.
Take regular breaks while working.
semantic_expansions: 规则的：处处合着同一把尺、匀齐
定期的/经常的：时间上也按尺子等距排开
words.recall_hint: regul（直尺）+ -ar → 合着同一把尺、故齐整

words.root_logic: regul（直尺）+ -ate（使…）→ 拿尺子把它校到位 → 调节、管束
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 regulare（按准尺处理），来自 regula
words.native_definition: to control the rate or level of something; to govern by rules
words.core_concept: holding a thing to the rod and trimming it to fit – 拿尺子比着，把它修到合线
words.core_image: 旋钮往回拧半圈，指针就落回刻线上
examples: A thermostat regulates the temperature.
New laws regulate online sales.
semantic_expansions: 调节/控制：拿尺子比着把它校到合线
管理：用成套准绳去管束
words.recall_hint: regul（直尺）+ -ate → 拿尺子把它校到位

words.root_logic: regulate（按尺校准）+ -ion → 立成条款的那把尺，及校准这件事
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 regulatio，来自 regulare ← regula
words.native_definition: an official rule; the act of controlling something
words.core_concept: the rod written down so all must be laid against it – 把那把尺写成条款，人人都得比着它
words.core_image: 墙上钉着一张表，每条都写明该照哪道线来
examples: Safety regulations must be followed.
The regulation of prices is disputed.
semantic_expansions: 规章/条例：写成条款、人人须比着的那把尺
调节：按尺校准这件事本身
words.recall_hint: regulate（按尺校准）+ -ion → 写成条款的那把尺

words.root_logic: hērōs（受尊崇的勇士）→ 因胆识受人传颂的人；也指故事里的主角
words.origin: 拉丁语 heros，来自希腊语 hērōs（半神的勇士）
words.native_definition: a person admired for courage; the chief character in a story
words.core_concept: the one whose deed the others keep retelling – 事迹被旁人一再讲起的那个人
words.core_image: 火堆边的人又提起他，那一关闯得众人服气
examples: He was hailed as a hero.
The hero of the novel is a doctor.
semantic_expansions: 英雄：因胆识被一再传颂的人
男主角：故事里被讲述的那个中心人物
words.recall_hint: hērōs（受尊崇的勇士）→ 事迹被一再讲起的人

words.root_logic: hero（被传颂者）+ -ic（…的）→ 够得上被传颂的那种
words.origin: 希腊语 hērōikos（属于勇士的），来自 hērōs
words.native_definition: very brave; showing great courage
words.core_concept: of the kind that gets retold afterwards – 属于事后会被人讲起的那一种
words.core_image: 他冲进去那一下，后来被人反复说起
examples: She made a heroic effort to save him.
It was a heroic act of defiance.
semantic_expansions: 英勇的/英雄的：够得上事后被人传颂的那种
words.recall_hint: hero（被传颂者）+ -ic → 够得上被传颂的那种

words.root_logic: hero（被传颂者）+ -ine（阴性）→ 女性的那一位；也指故事女主角
words.origin: 希腊语 hērōinē（女勇士），hērōs 的阴性形
words.native_definition: a woman admired for courage; the chief female character in a story
words.core_concept: the woman whose deed the others keep retelling – 事迹被旁人一再讲起的那位女性
words.core_image: 那家人至今说起她夜里背人出来的事
examples: She became a national heroine.
The heroine escapes in the last act.
semantic_expansions: 女英雄：因胆识被传颂的女性
女主角：故事里被讲述的那位女性中心人物
words.recall_hint: hero（被传颂者）+ -ine（阴性）→ 女性的那一位

words.root_logic: jour（日）+ -nal → 按日记下的册子 → 日志；引申为定期出的刊物
words.origin: 古法语 jornal（每日的记事），来自拉丁语 diurnalis ← diurnus（一日的）
words.native_definition: a daily record of events; a magazine on a special subject
words.core_concept: the book that takes one entry per day – 一天记一笔的那本册子
words.core_image: 每晚睡前写一行，一年下来那本厚了一截
examples: She keeps a journal of her travels.
The paper appeared in a medical journal.
semantic_expansions: 日志/日记：按日记下的那本册子
期刊：同样按期出的那类刊物
words.recall_hint: jour（日）+ -nal → 一天记一笔的那本册子

words.root_logic: journal（按日的刊）+ -ist（司此业者）→ 替这类刊物采写的人
words.origin: 法语 journaliste，来自 journal ← 拉丁语 diurnus
words.native_definition: a person who writes news for papers, radio, or television
words.core_concept: the one who fills the daily pages – 把那按日出的版面填起来的人
words.core_image: 他赶在天黑前把稿子发回去，好赶上明早那一版
examples: The journalist interviewed both sides.
She trained as a journalist.
semantic_expansions: 记者/新闻工作者：替按日出的刊物采写的人
words.recall_hint: journal（按日的刊）+ -ist → 替它采写的人

words.root_logic: jour（日）+ -ney → 本指一天能走完的路程，后泛指整趟行程
words.origin: 古法语 jornee（一天的路程、一天的活），来自 jour（日）← 拉丁语 diurnus
words.native_definition: an act of travelling from one place to another
words.core_concept: as far as one gets between sunup and dark, extended to the whole trip – 天亮到天黑能走的那一段，后指整趟
words.core_image: 清早动身，日头落时到了下一个镇子
examples: The journey takes about three hours.
They set out on a long journey.
semantic_expansions: 旅程/行程：本指一天走完的路，后指整趟路途
旅行：走这段路这件事
words.recall_hint: jour（日）+ -ney → 一天能走完的路，引申为整趟

words.root_logic: metron（量度）→ 定作标准的那一段长；诗里指音步的节拍
words.origin: 法语 mètre，来自希腊语 metron（量具、音步）
words.native_definition: a unit of length equal to 100 centimetres; the rhythm of verse
words.core_concept: the one length agreed on as the yardstick – 公认拿来当准的那一段长
words.core_image: 地上那道标线到下一道，正好是定死的一段
examples: The room is four metres wide.
The poem is written in strict metre.
semantic_expansions: 米：公认作准的那一段长
韵律：诗句里按拍子量出的节奏
words.recall_hint: metron（量度）→ 定作标准的那一段长

words.root_logic: metr（量度）+ -ic（…的）→ 按这套尺度来的
words.origin: 法语 métrique，来自希腊语 metrikos（关于量度的）← metron
words.native_definition: relating to the system based on metres and grams
words.core_concept: belonging to the one agreed set of measures – 属于那一套公认尺度的
words.core_image: 秤和尺换成同一套标法，各处报出的数才对得上
examples: Britain uses metric units now.
Convert the figures to metric.
semantic_expansions: 公制的/度量的：按那一套公认尺度来的
words.recall_hint: metr（量度）+ -ic → 按这套尺度来的

words.root_logic: sym-（syn- 一同）+ metr（量度）+ -y → 两边照同一尺量得一样 → 对称
words.origin: 希腊语 symmetria（同一尺度、匀称），来自 syn（一同）＋metron（量度）
words.native_definition: the quality of having two halves that match exactly
words.core_concept: both sides coming out equal when laid to the same measure – 拿同一把尺量两边，数一样
words.core_image: 蝴蝶合起翅膀，左右两片严丝合缝地叠在一起
examples: The building has perfect symmetry.
There is a pleasing symmetry to the design.
semantic_expansions: 对称/匀称：两边照同一尺量出来一样
words.recall_hint: sym-（一同）+ metr（量度）→ 两边量得一样

words.root_logic: placere（使中意）→ 让对方合意；作副词时是「若合你意」的省说，即请
words.origin: 古法语 plaisir（使满意），来自拉丁语 placere（使中意、讨喜）
words.native_definition: to make someone glad; used politely to ask for something
words.core_concept: bringing a thing round to what the other finds agreeable – 把事情做到对方合意那一步
words.core_image: 他把茶端到手边，对方眉头一松
examples: It pleased her to hear the news.
Please close the door behind you.
semantic_expansions: 使高兴/使满意：做到对方合意那一步
请：说话时以「若合你意」相求
words.recall_hint: placere（使中意）→ 做到对方合意；「若合你意」即请

words.root_logic: please（使合意）+ -ant（正…的）→ 正让人合意的
words.origin: 古法语 plaisant（讨喜的），plaisir 的现在分词 ← 拉丁语 placere
words.native_definition: enjoyable; giving a feeling of satisfaction
words.core_concept: of the kind that sits well with whoever meets it – 遇上的人都觉得受用的那种
words.core_image: 屋里温度刚好，坐下来谁都不想起身
examples: We had a pleasant evening together.
She has a pleasant manner.
semantic_expansions: 令人愉快的/宜人的：正让人合意受用的
友善的：待人的样子也让人合意
words.recall_hint: please（使合意）+ -ant → 正让人合意的

words.root_logic: please（使合意）+ -ure（名词）→ 合意时心里那份受用
words.origin: 古法语 plaisir（快乐），本是动词不定式用作名词 ← 拉丁语 placere
words.native_definition: a feeling of happy satisfaction; something that gives this
words.core_concept: what one feels when a thing lands just right – 事情正合意时心里那份受用
words.core_image: 他听完往椅背上一靠，脸上的紧绷散了
examples: Reading gives him great pleasure.
It is a pleasure to meet you.
semantic_expansions: 乐趣/愉快：正合意时心里那份受用
荣幸：把此事当作合意之事来说的客气话
words.recall_hint: please（使合意）+ -ure → 合意时心里那份受用

words.root_logic: consuetudo（惯常）→ 一地长年照做的成例；按成例缴的税即关税一义
words.origin: 古法语 costume，来自拉丁语 consuetudo（惯常）← consuescere（习惯于）
words.native_definition: a way of behaving long established in a place; duties paid on imports
words.core_concept: what a place has done so long that it now counts as proper – 一地做久了、如今被认作该那么做的事
words.core_image: 每年这天各家都摆一样的供品，谁也说不清是从哪辈起的
examples: It is a local custom to bring flowers.
The goods were held at customs.
semantic_expansions: 习俗/惯例：一地长年照做、被认作该如此的事
关税：旧时按成例向过境货物征收的那笔
words.recall_hint: consuetudo（惯常）→ 做久成例；按例缴的税即关税

words.root_logic: custom（成例）+ -ary（…的）→ 照成例来的、素来如此的
words.origin: 拉丁语 consuetudinarius（依惯例的），来自 consuetudo
words.native_definition: according to what is usually done
words.core_concept: following the groove already worn in – 顺着早被踩出来的那道沟走
words.core_image: 他照素来的做法先斟茶再落座，一步没差
examples: It is customary to tip the driver.

semantic_expansions: 习惯上的/惯常的：顺着早已踩出的那道沟来
words.recall_hint: custom（成例）+ -ary → 顺着旧沟、素来如此

words.root_logic: custom（惯常照顾）+ -er（人）→ 惯常上门买东西的那个人
words.origin: 英语 customer，来自 custom（惯常光顾）← 拉丁语 consuetudo

words.core_concept: the one who keeps coming back to the same counter – 一趟趟回到同一个柜台的那个人
words.core_image: 掌柜一抬头就知道他要哪一样，来的回数太多了
examples: The shop has many regular customers.
A customer complained about the delay.
semantic_expansions: 顾客/客户：惯常回到同一处买东西的人
words.recall_hint: custom（惯常光顾）+ -er → 一趟趟回来的那个人

words.root_logic: favere（善待、偏袒）→ 给某一边的好意；也指为人做的那件方便事
words.origin: 古法语 favour，来自拉丁语 favor（好意、青睐）← favere
words.native_definition: kind approval or support; a kind act done for someone
words.core_concept: the good will turned toward one side – 朝某一边送去的那份好意
words.core_image: 他把手一挥，众人的掌声全往那一边去了
examples: Could you do me a favor?

semantic_expansions: 恩惠：为人做的那件方便事
赞成/偏爱：心朝某一边送去的好意
words.recall_hint: favere（善待偏袒）→ 朝某一边送去的好意

words.root_logic: favor（好意）+ -able（可…的）→ 带着好意的、于我有利的
words.origin: 拉丁语 favorabilis（讨喜的、有利的），来自 favor ← favere
words.native_definition: showing approval; helpful and likely to bring advantage
words.core_concept: with the wind leaning one's own way – 风向偏在自己这一边
words.core_image: 风顺着帆往前推，船比预定快了半日
examples: The weather was favorable for sailing.
She gave a favorable reply.
semantic_expansions: 赞同的：带着好意的
有利的/顺利的：势头偏在自己这一边
words.recall_hint: favor（好意）+ -able → 好意所向、势头偏向自己

words.root_logic: favor（偏爱）+ -ite（受…的）→ 得那份偏爱最多的
words.origin: 意大利语 favorito（受宠者），来自 favorire ← 拉丁语 favere
words.native_definition: liked more than all others of the same kind
words.core_concept: the one the leaning always settles on – 那份偏心总落在它头上
words.core_image: 一柜子的杯子，他伸手拿的永远是同一只
examples: This is my favorite song.
Blue is her favorite color.
semantic_expansions: 最喜欢的/最爱的：偏心总落在它头上的那一个
words.recall_hint: favor（偏爱）+ -ite → 偏心总落在它头上

words.root_logic: pingere（涂色）→ 敷到面上的那种颜色；也指作画这件事
words.origin: 古法语 peint（涂过的），peindre 的过去分词 ← 拉丁语 pingere
words.native_definition: coloured liquid put on a surface; to make a picture with colour
words.core_concept: the colour laid on, and the laying of it – 敷上去的那层色，以及敷色这件事
words.core_image: 刷子在板上来回一趟，后头的木纹就看不见了
examples: The door needs a fresh coat of paint.
She paints in oils.
semantic_expansions: 油漆/颜料：敷到面上的那层色
绘画：把色敷成图这件事
words.recall_hint: pingere（涂色）→ 敷到面上的那层色及敷色之事

words.root_logic: paint（敷色）+ -er（人）→ 干敷色这活的人：作画的或刷漆的
words.origin: 英语 painter，来自 paint ← 拉丁语 pingere
words.native_definition: a person who paints pictures, or who paints buildings as a job
words.core_concept: the one whose work is laying colour on – 以敷色为活计的那个人
words.core_image: 他蹲在梯子下调色，桶边一圈干了的痕
examples: The painter finished the portrait.
We hired a painter for the kitchen.
semantic_expansions: 画家：以敷色作画为业的人
油漆工：以敷色刷面为业的人
words.recall_hint: paint（敷色）+ -er → 干敷色这活的人

words.root_logic: paint（敷色）+ -ing → 敷色所成之物，及敷色这门事
words.origin: 英语 painting，来自 paint 的动名词 ← 拉丁语 pingere
words.native_definition: a picture made with paint; the art or act of painting
words.core_concept: what the laid colour has become – 那层色最后成了的样子
words.core_image: 框子里那一幅挂上墙，颜色厚得能看出笔痕
examples: The painting hangs in the hall.
She studied painting in Paris.
semantic_expansions: 画作：敷色所成的那一幅
绘画：敷色成图这门事本身
words.recall_hint: paint（敷色）+ -ing → 敷色所成之物与其事

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ peri（试）+ -ence → 亲身试过后留下来的那点本事
words.origin: 拉丁语 experientia（试验所得），来自 experiri（亲身试过）
words.native_definition: knowledge or skill gained by doing something; an event one lives through
words.core_concept: what stays with one after having tried it – 试过之后留在身上的那点东西
words.core_image: 手在水里试过几回，伸进去就知道够不够烫
examples: She has years of teaching experience.
It was a frightening experience.
semantic_expansions: 经验：亲身试过后留下的本事
体验/经历：亲身走过的那一遭
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ peri（试）→ 试过后留在身上的东西

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ peri（试）+ -ment → 特意安排的一次试，看会出什么
words.origin: 拉丁语 experimentum（试验、检验），来自 experiri
words.native_definition: a scientific test done to find out what happens
words.core_concept: a trying set up on purpose to see what comes out – 特意摆开来试一次，看结果怎样
words.core_image: 两只杯子只差一样条件，摆在一处等着看分别
examples: They ran the experiment three times.

semantic_expansions: 实验/试验：特意安排的一次试，用来看结果

words.root_logic: experiment（试一次）+ -al（…的）→ 尚在试的、拿来试的
words.origin: 英语 experimental，来自 experiment ← 拉丁语 experiri
words.native_definition: based on new methods not yet proved; used for testing
words.core_concept: still at the trying stage, not yet settled – 还在试的阶段，尚未定下来
words.core_image: 那台机器还摆在台上，参数天天改
examples: The treatment is still experimental.
They set up an experimental farm.
semantic_expansions: 实验的/试验性的：还在试、尚未定下来的
words.recall_hint: experiment（试一次）+ -al → 还在试的阶段

words.root_logic: planus（平面）→ 画在平面上的图样 → 打算、方案；动词即谋划
words.origin: 法语 plan（平面图），来自拉丁语 planus（平的）
words.native_definition: a detailed proposal for doing something; a drawing seen from above
words.core_concept: the layout drawn flat before anything is built – 动工之前先摊在平面上画出来的那套
words.core_image: 桌上铺开一张图，每一处都先在纸上定好位置
examples: We made a plan for the weekend.
The architect showed us the floor plan.
semantic_expansions: 计划/方案：动工前先在平面上定下的那套
平面图：从上方看、摊平画出的那张图
words.recall_hint: planus（平面）→ 先摊平画出来的那套

words.root_logic: planus（平的）→ 平面；机翼是平展的面，故 aeroplane 截短为 plane；刨子是找平的工具
words.origin: 拉丁语 planus（平的）；飞机义来自 aeroplane（aer 空气＋planus 平面）的截短
words.native_definition: a flat surface; an aircraft; a tool for smoothing wood
words.core_concept: a face with no rise in it, and things named for such a face – 没有起伏的那个面，以及以此得名之物
words.core_image: 推子沿着木头走过去，凸起的一层卷成花掉在地上
examples: Draw two lines on the same plane.
Our plane landed on time.
semantic_expansions: 平面：没有起伏的那个面
飞机：因平展机翼得名（aeroplane 截短）
刨子：把面找平的那件工具
words.recall_hint: planus（平的）→ 无起伏的面，及因此得名之物

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ plan（平）+ -ation → 把褶子摊平摊开 → 讲清楚的那番话
words.origin: 拉丁语 explanatio（阐明），来自 explanare（摊平、讲清）← ex＋planus
words.native_definition: a statement that makes something clear or gives a reason
words.core_concept: smoothing the folds out until the whole thing lies plain – 把褶皱一一摊开，整件事平平摆着
words.core_image: 他把揉皱的那张纸一点点抹平，字才认得出来
examples: He gave no explanation for the delay.
Her explanation satisfied everyone.

解释的理由：摊平之后露出来的原委
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ plan（平）→ 把褶子摊开讲清

words.root_logic: planta（幼苗）→ 长在土里的活物；动词是把苗按进土里。厂房义由「设置安放」引申
words.origin: 古英语 plante 借自拉丁语 planta（幼苗），动词 plantare（栽种）
words.native_definition: a living thing that grows in soil; a factory; to put in the ground to grow
words.core_concept: the shoot set into soil, and by extension anything set in place to work – 按进土里的那株苗，引申为安置到位以运作之物
words.core_image: 苗根塞进坑里，土一踩实，叶子第二天就抬起来了
examples: Water the plants every morning.
They plant rice in early summer.

种植：把苗按进土里这件事
工厂：由「安置到位以运作」引申而来的厂房
words.recall_hint: planta（幼苗）→ 按进土里的苗；引申为安置到位之物

words.root_logic: plant（栽种）+ -ation → 成片栽种的那块地
words.origin: 拉丁语 plantatio（栽种），来自 plantare ← planta
words.native_definition: a large area where crops such as tea or rubber are grown
words.core_concept: ground where the setting-in was done row upon row – 一垄接一垄都按进苗去的那片地
words.core_image: 一垄接一垄望不到头，每株间距都一样
examples: He works on a tea plantation.
The plantation covers two hundred acres.
semantic_expansions: 种植园/人造林：成片按苗栽下的那块地
words.recall_hint: plant（栽种）+ -ation → 成片栽下苗的那块地

words.root_logic: trans-（转移）+ plant（栽）→ 起出来栽到别处 → 移栽；医学上指移植器官
words.origin: 拉丁语 transplantare（移栽），来自 trans＋plantare ← planta
words.native_definition: to move a plant to another place; to move an organ into another body
words.core_concept: lifting what was set in one spot and setting it into another – 把按在这处的起出来，按到那处去
words.core_image: 带着根土整株起出来，挪到新坑里再踩实
examples: We transplanted the seedlings today.
He received a heart transplant.
semantic_expansions: 移栽：把苗起出来栽到别处
移植：同一动作用在器官上
words.recall_hint: trans-（转移）+ plant（栽）→ 起出来按到别处

words.root_logic: polit（城邦公事）+ -ics（…之学/之事）→ 争夺与处置公共事务这一摊
words.origin: 希腊语 politika（城邦事务），来自 politikos ← polis（城邦）
